items.text:
Ostranauts é um jogo divertido, contudo ainda precisa de grandes melhorias em algumas áreas críticas ao meu ver, algumas técnicas, e algumas em termos de gameplay/conteúdo. Eu definitivamente vejo potêncial nesse jogo se tornar algo similar a Rimworld misturado com The Expanse, mas ainda há bastante a ser feito. Por isso gostaria de deixar uma review neutra mas como não é uma opção, vou deixar recomendado pois acretido que tudo isso abaixo pode ser consertado com tempo.

Alguns dos problemas que vejo com o jogo:

* As mecanicas de construção do jogo são um tanto o quanto limitadas. Em específico, não parece ser possível construir algo/colocar uma tarefa de construção num lugar onde um dos seus tripulantes não está vendo. Ou seja, é necessário as vezes colocar alguém dentro de uma sala apenas para poder colocar as ordens de construção desejadas. Basicamente uma mecânica de neblina de guerra/fog of war, algo perfeitamente normal numa situação de combate e tudo mais, contudo, fora destas situações (ex: parado num porto, ou flutuando no espaço sem ninguém por perto) ela simplesmente torna construção bem mais lenta do que deveria ser.

* A inteligência artifical dos NPCs e tripulantes é questionável. Tanto as mecanicas de chat com NPCs para formar amizades/recrutamento/etc, assim como das naves dos NPCs que aparentemente aceleram/desaceleram extremamente rápido (tipo acelerar 10KM/s em questões de segundos). Acompanhei um youtuber jogando uma versão pre-lançamento do jogo e isso parece ter sido melhorado na versão lançada, mas ainda perto dos portos é comum ver isso.

* As tarefas de hauling não são nada eficientes, quase nunca faz sentido usar elas. Por exemplo, se você quer transportar 50x pisos de uma nave sucata para dentro da sua, os tripulantes vão pegar 5x-10x pisos por vez ao invés de encher seu inventário. Supostamente tem mods que consertam isso, mas o jogo foi atualizado e os mods ainda não foram atualizados para ser compativeis novamente. Também não tem nenhuma ordem de "pegar tudo" solto em uma area para o inventário, o que seria melhor em alguns cenários. Tipo deixar o hauling para coisas grandes demais para mochila/carrinho e um pegar tudo para o resto.

* Não é possível agendar tarefas, tipo clicar para um personagem fazer algo, e depois shift+click para ele andar para outro lugar após. As ordens do jogo são úteis para coisas que você faz em massa, mas para um micro-gerenciamento estilo Rimworld não são suficientes.

* A ordem de execução das ordens é bem tosca, e claramente ele vare sequencialmente cada tile, de cima para baixo, executando as tarefas que ele encontra e consegue fazer, e depois prosseguindo para a próxima tile para direita. Não tem qualquer tipo de preferencia por proximidade ou similar. Isso não seria um problema tão grande, até você considerar que cada vez que um tripulante entra/sai da nave você vai perder um pouco de atmosfera para o espaço, e essa ordem de execução de cima->baixo meio que maximiza o numero de abre/fecha das suas portas pois a airlock principal fica no meio da tela e tudo mais. É algo simples de resolver em termos de programação, basta adicionar um peso de proximidade e/ou um offset no valor de preferencia de uma tarfefa quando ela involve cruzar uma airlock.

* O ponto assima também se manifesta ao minerar, onde o tripulante vai parar de continuar a cavar um túnel após quebrar um bloco, e iniciar a cavar uma outra tile que você marcou. Isso pois ao fazer um túnel o os tiles/blocos alcançáveis são feitos, e então quando ele termina ele não verifica se blocos adjacentes agora são alcançáveis, e, portanto, marca a tarefa como inacançável temporariamente e vai minerar outra ordem que você marcou. Basicamente forçando a pessoa a marcar somente uma linha de mineração por vez.

*  Não sei ao certo se é um problema do jogo em sí, mas ao menos jogando no Linux através do Proton ele parece ter um vazamento gradual de memória. Tenho um PC com 32GB de RAM, e jogando normalmente com desempenho bom por algumas horas ele eventualmente vai consumindo mais e mais RAM até que eventualmente é morto por falta de memória. Não culpo o jogo por isso necessáriamente pois não sei se é algum problema da camada de compatibilidade Proton.
items.text_zh:
Ostranauts 是一款有趣的游戏，不过在我看来，它仍然需要在一些关键领域进行重大改进，有些是技术方面的，有些是玩法/内容方面的。我绝对看到了这款游戏有潜力成为类似 Rimworld 与 The Expanse 混合体的东西，但还有很多工作要做。因此我想留下一份中立的评测，但既然这不是一个选项，我会留下推荐，因为我相信下面所有这些都可以随着时间得到修复。

我看到的游戏一些问题：

* 游戏的建造机制有些受限。具体来说，似乎无法在你的某个船员看不到的地方建造东西/放置建造任务。也就是说，有时必须把某人放进一个房间，仅仅是为了能够下达想要的建造命令。基本上就是一种战争迷雾机制，这在战斗等情况下完全正常，然而，在这些情况之外（例如：停靠在港口，或漂浮在太空中附近无人），它只会让建造变得比本该有的速度慢得多。

* NPC 和船员的 AI 值得怀疑。无论是与 NPC 聊天以建立友谊/招募等机制，还是 NPC 飞船似乎会极快地加速/减速（比如在几秒内加速 10KM/s）。我关注过一个 youtuber 玩这款游戏的预发布版本，这在发布版本中似乎有所改善，但在港口附近仍然很常见。

* 搬运任务一点也不高效，几乎从来都不值得使用它们。例如，如果你想从一艘废船上把 50x 地板运到你的船里，船员会一次拿 5x-10x 地板，而不是填满自己的库存。据说有 mod 可以修复这个问题，但游戏更新了，而 mod 还没有更新到再次兼容。也没有任何“全部拾取”散落在一个区域里的东西到库存的命令，这在某些场景下会更好。比如把搬运留给背包/推车装不下的太大东西，而用一个全部拾取来处理其余的东西。

* 无法安排任务，比如点击让一个角色做某事，然后 shift+点击让他在之后走到另一个地方。游戏的命令对于你批量做的事情很有用，但对于 Rimworld 风格的微观管理来说还不够。

* 命令的执行顺序相当粗糙，而且很明显它会从上到下依次遍历每个 tile，执行它遇到且能做的任务，然后继续到右边下一个 tile。它没有任何按距离远近或类似方式的偏好。这本来不会是个太大的问题，直到你考虑到每次一个船员进出飞船，你都会损失一点大气到太空中，而这种从上到下的执行顺序在某种程度上最大化了你的门开/关次数，因为主气闸位于屏幕中间等等。从编程角度来说这很容易解决，只需在任务涉及穿过气闸时添加一个距离权重和/或对任务偏好值加一个偏移。

* 上面这一点在采矿时也会表现出来，船员在打破一个方块后会停止继续挖一条隧道，并开始挖你标记的另一个 tile。这是因为在挖隧道时，可到达的 tiles/方块会被处理，然后当他完成时，他不会检查相邻方块现在是否可到达，因此暂时把任务标记为不可到达，并去挖你标记的另一个命令。基本上就是强迫人一次只标记一条采矿线。

* 我不确定这到底是不是游戏本身的问题，但至少在 Linux 上通过 Proton 玩时，它似乎有逐渐的内存泄漏。我有一台 32GB RAM 的 PC，正常玩且性能良好几个小时后，它最终会消耗越来越多的 RAM，直到最终因内存不足而被杀死。我不一定因此责怪游戏，因为我不知道这是不是 Proton 兼容层的问题。

items.text:
The game has a lot of potential but the Quality of Life isn't there. It feels rushed putting this into 1.0 whenever you have so many core mechanics that feel super clunky.

I'd recommend that the developers play one play through where they kind of wander around and do beginner salvaging for a while and take note of all the little inconveniences in the game (or if they think they can't do that without speed running omega strong gear, they get someone else to play and they watch).

For example, when you set a task and try to go do something else briefly (say you need to go get food or water at a kiosk or a derelict) and you walk out of you air lock in the common sense manner (waiting for the airlock door to close so you don't lose pressure) your character will take control anytime you idle for more than 1 second while waiting and barrel through the airlock releasing all the air in your ship while trying to reach the task you had set and walked away from. THE WORST PART IS! The character is NOT in Autotask mode and will keep going back to it until you cancel it (because you can't pause it)! A smart person or a dev might say to this "just go to the roster and prohibit the character from opening the airlock", guess what! That means that I cannot open the airlock either! 

or

If you are trying to expand your ship using the walls, floors, and conduit of a derelict when you set a task of installing the components, the character takes one. piece. at. a. time. back. and. forth. forever. 
That gets really old. really fast. and if you want to speed it up by manually picking up every. single. tile. you have to click an average of 3-5 times for every single tile. Once you move to the tile, once to select the grid, once more to select the tile (or spam click until the "lottery" layers give you the floor tile), and another time to select the "pick up" button.

or

If you want to find someone for a goal and it brings you to the social app. You find the person, then select their location, you're 1 tile outside of your ship so you can't access your docked ship's NAV map. You have to then close the PDA, go into your ship, go to the goal, go to the person, then go to their location, and finally... their location can't be found. At this point you have 2 or 3 options, you can get everything ready to undock your ship and travel far enough from and visual or radio obstruction to then go through the whole process to find the person's location again and finally... you still can't find them on the map or thru the hailing system. They are gone. They have ceased to exist. The last option is to wait, seemingly indefinitely for them to come back to what ever station/system you are in. The cherry on top is that everytime you go to the social app, you have to re-find the person everytime and there is not search bar. You have to scroll through everytime. And it doesn't put you at the top or both of the list, it puts you in the middle so you have to search twice to find a person. Scrolling your mouse skips along the pages so you don't even know if you have passed them already (I will note that there is a scroll bar but why can't I use my mouse scroll???).


These things are all CORE mechanics that you WILL use throughout the entirety of your play through. Why are they still not fixed? And this is just the tip of the iceberg there are SO MANY systems that rely on the examples that I used. In effect, this is like building a house and not pouring the foundation so the house is crooked and leaning to the side.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏潜力巨大，但生活质量方面却差强人意。当你还有那么多核心机制感觉超级笨拙的时候，把它放进1.0版本感觉太仓促了。

我建议开发者玩一遍游戏，四处闲逛，做一会儿新手打捞，并记录下游戏中所有的小不便（或者如果他们觉得不速通拿到超强装备就做不到，那就让别人来玩，他们在旁边看）。

比如说，当你设定了一个任务，然后想短暂地去做点别的事（比如你需要去售货亭或废弃飞船弄点食物或水），你以常识方式走出气闸（等待气闸门关闭以免失去气压），你的角色会在你等待时闲置超过1秒的任何时候接管控制，冲过气闸，释放你飞船里的所有空气，试图到达你设定后又走开的任务。最糟糕的部分是！角色并没有处于自动任务模式，会一直回去直到你取消它（因为你无法暂停它）！一个聪明人或开发者可能会说“直接去花名册禁止角色打开气闸”，你猜怎么着！那意味着我也不能打开气闸了！

或者

如果你试图用废弃飞船的墙壁、地板和管道来扩展你的飞船，当你设定安装组件的任务时，角色会一次。一。件。地。来回。永远。
那真的很快。就让人厌烦。如果你想通过手动拾取每。一。个。地砖来加速，你必须为每个地砖平均点击3-5次。一次移动到地砖，一次选择网格，再一次选择地砖（或者狂点直到“抽奖”层给你地板砖），还有一次选择“拾取”按钮。

或者

如果你想为某个目标找人，它带你到社交应用。你找到那个人，然后选择他们的位置，你在飞船外1格，所以无法访问你停靠飞船的导航地图。你必须关闭PDA，进入你的飞船，去目标，去那个人，然后去他们的位置，最后……他们的位置找不到了。此时你有2或3个选项，你可以准备好一切，解开飞船停靠，行驶到远离任何视觉或无线电障碍的地方，然后重新走整个流程再次找到那个人的位置，最后……你仍然无法在地图上或通过呼叫系统找到他们。他们消失了。他们不复存在了。最后一个选项是等待，似乎无限期地等待他们回到你所在的任何空间站/星系。最妙的是，每次你去社交应用，你都必须重新找到那个人，而且没有搜索栏。你必须每次都滚动浏览。而且它不会把你放在列表的顶部或底部，而是放在中间，所以你必须搜索两次才能找到一个人。鼠标滚动会跳过页面，所以你甚至不知道是否已经经过了他们（我会注意到有一个滚动条，但为什么我不能用鼠标滚轮？？？）。


这些都是核心机制，你会在整个游戏过程中一直使用。为什么它们还没有被修复？而这只是冰山一角，有太多系统依赖于我用的这些例子。实际上，这就像建房子却不打地基，所以房子歪歪扭扭，向一边倾斜。
房子是歪的，向一侧倾斜。

items.text:
This is that rare case where a Neutral recommendation would fit perfectly. I marked it as No, but that is not a negative verdict. I like the game a lot — I just want other buyers to know what they are stepping into. I have 250+ hours in it, and I have barely flown outside the starting OKLG area. I had so much fun there that I stayed… and that is exactly where the current shortcomings became obvious.

The good (short list — it is a decent game, so these are the standouts):

- A great, hardcore space sim with a lot of freedom
- Excellent start: character creation and the mortgage make the opening hours properly challenging
- Solid shipbuilding, including bits you can scavenge from derelicts
- A scavenger economy that actually hurts. You feel it when a part is missing, the nearby station does not have it, and you have to cut and sell a liver to afford it
- You pay for everything — including the ability to take a breath
- Flying through a customizable navigation panel. Painful at first, and it takes getting used to, but it is a genuinely good idea

What you have to be ready for - negatives -  (the longer list — this is why I stopped where I did, hoping for a better experience later):

- It may be labelled 1.0, but it does not feel like it, especially on optimisation. After the last patch, the OKLG docking area has about 3× as many NPCs, and the game slows down badly. Running at 4× while retrofitting ships is basically undoable. UI is not decoupled from simulation either: when it stutters, you cannot even pause. That suggests little or no multithreading.
- Task ordering. You can queue work for yourself or a small crew (I never got far with crew; I used my main character and a task list, which is far more efficient than doing jobs one by one). With a large queue — for example stripping a whole derelict — tasks run line by line, top-down or bottom-up, instead of nearest-next. I assume the task creator just scans in vertical rows. The result is a lot of wasted walking when the character starts a new “line.”
- No mass task cancel. If you realise mid-way you made a mistake, you delete jobs one by one. That can mean a few hundred clicks. We already have an Orders “painter.” A cancel painter would be an obvious next step.
I completely accept hand-managing the ship at the start: scrap hull, scavenge, patch, refill O2 bottles for EVA suits, manually fill N2/O2 canisters outside a station. Later, though, I expected access to more expensive, higher-tier gear that automates some of this — EVA bottle refill stations, piping so scavenged N2 canisters can feed a refill network, popping installed canisters from barrels, and especially automatic pressure detection.
- Automatic hauling is atrocious, including installing parts on the ship. Characters often keep dragging an item even after that item’s job is already supplied — sometimes by the same character. They deliver a few pieces, start dragging a wall, then freeze because there is “no space” to carry the next thing.
- Wall building assumes a perfectly clean space. The character will not clear debris first. You babysit and micromanage, or the job fails.
- Hauling to designated areas is a mess. Items often end up outside the zone, or even outside the ship, behind the walls. Typical haul-order behaviour: (1) they carry items one by one, or only a few similar ones, well below capacity; (2) they drag an item to the drop point, then happily drag it back while going for the next one; (3) they take things from your haul area and dump them back on the derelict they were supposed to empty. This was the last straw. If I had an NPC crew making that kind of mess, I would rage-space them without EVA suits.
- Character dialogue is bad. I know the game is task-based, but conversations do not fit that model (wait, reply, wait, reply). Combat is the same: task commands you have to repeat on the target. The command order also changes, so I mixed up “slap” and “stab” more than once.
- Micro-asteroids are frustrating — not because they exist. For a project this realistic, they belong. The problem is I found myself repairing the exact same spot up to eight times in a row while stripping a derelict. Hits have no graduated damage: they always shred wall + floor + circuits to the breaking point, never halfway.
- Floor and wall strength barely matter. Weight is the only value that counts. Heavier “luxury” parts and more militaristic ones are just role-play.
- The building app desperately needs parts grouped by family instead of one long list.
- A ship cargo manifest is a must. I cannot remember whether I have 110 or 210 floor pieces when collecting for a retrofit.
- Fusion-reactor logistics (the large canisters) really need pipelines — a proper pumping system, and a way to refill HE3 from scavenged canisters. Water is the same: no plumbing; you still haul bottles to sinks.
- Relatively little part variation. There is a lot of equipment, but each piece has one job. You rarely get competing tiers (air pump vs turbo air pump, normal intake vs Hydra intake). Stats are also thin: power draw while working vs idle, and so on.
- Characters swapping batteries in devices or EVA suits tend to dump stuff on the floor. I have also seen them forget to swap EVA batteries or O2 bottles while working, then stand there gasping.
- Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA. Also when on derelict you have no remote access to you own Nav station, so even if you get some signal about some event, you can't check anything until you back into you ship "map"
- Considering how fast you can get rick with meat and scavenged cargo holds... we need more equipment in various price ranges or more difficult / time-consuming repairs (which would require more durability in exchange). My last save was about 5.6MLN, without flying of OKLG - starting area. I just happen to land on very HEAVILY infested ship so I played the butcher.
- And more I have forgotten for now.

This is a great idea wrapped in a lot of small frustrations. Nothing is fundamentally broken, and playing is fun — until you get tired of fighting the systems. A lot of this could be mods; the Workshop already has several attempts. I get the feeling the codebase is still in flux, though, so a mod that works today may not survive the next patch.

If you can live with the above, you will have a great time. I did — especially in the first 100 hours. After that I started hitting walls: the automation I'd  expect as I progress is not there, and it looks like I will have to micromanage everything forever. Definitely not wasted time. Just a bit disappointed.
items.text_zh:
这是那种罕见的情况，一个“中立”推荐会完美契合。我把它标记为“不推荐”，但那并不是负面评价。我非常喜欢这款游戏——我只是想让其他买家知道他们要面对什么。我在里面已经玩了250多个小时，而我几乎没有飞出过起始的OKLG区域。我在那里玩得太开心了，所以就留了下来……而正是在那里，当前的缺点变得显而易见。

优点（简短列表——这是一款不错的游戏，所以这些是突出之处）：

- 一款出色、硬核且自由度很高的太空模拟游戏
- 极佳的开局：角色创建和房贷让最初几个小时的挑战性恰到好处
- 扎实的造船系统，包括可以从废弃飞船中打捞到的零件
- 一种真的会让你感到肉痛的拾荒经济。当缺少一个零件、附近空间站又没有、而你不得不割下一个肝卖掉才买得起时，你能真切感受到这一点
- 一切都要花钱——包括呼吸的能力
- 通过可自定义的导航面板飞行。起初很痛苦，也需要时间适应，但这确实是个好主意

你必须准备好面对的事——缺点——（更长的列表——这就是我为什么停在了当时那个进度，希望以后能有更好的体验）：

- 它可能被标为1.0，但感觉并不像，尤其是在优化方面。上次补丁之后，OKLG停靠区大约多了3倍的NPC，游戏严重变慢。改装飞船时以4倍速运行基本没法玩。UI也没有与模拟解耦：卡顿时，你甚至无法暂停。这说明多线程很少或根本没有。
- 任务排序。你可以为自己或一个小船员队列安排工作（我从未在船员方面走得很远；我用主角和一个任务列表，这比一件件做工作高效得多）。当队列很大时——例如拆解一整艘废弃飞船——任务会按行、自上而下或自下而上运行，而不是按最近的下一个执行。我猜任务创建器只是按垂直行扫描。结果是，当角色开始新的一“行”时，会浪费大量走路时间。
- 没有批量取消任务。如果你中途意识到自己犯了错，就只能一个个删除工作。那可能意味着几百次点击。我们已经有了订单“画笔”。取消画笔显然是下一步。
我完全接受开局时手动管理飞船：刮船体、拾荒、修补、为EVA服补充O2瓶、在空间站外手动填充N2/O2罐。但后来，我期待能获得更昂贵、更高档的装备来自动化其中一些事情——EVA瓶补充站、让打捞来的N2罐接入补充网络的管道、从桶中取出已安装的罐，尤其是自动压力检测。
- 自动搬运糟糕透顶，包括在飞船上安装零件。角色常常在该物品的工作已经被供给之后还继续拖着它——有时还是同一个角色。他们送了几件东西，开始拖一堵墙，然后因为“没有空间”携带下一件东西而卡住。
- 建造墙壁假定空间完全干净。角色不会先清理碎片。你要么像保姆一样微观管理，要么工作失败。
- 搬运到指定区域一团糟。物品常常最终落在区域外，甚至飞船外、墙后面。典型的搬运命令行为：（1）他们一件件搬，或者只搬几件相似的，远低于容量；（2）他们把物品拖到投放点，然后在去拿下一件时又高高兴兴地把它拖回去；（3）他们从你的搬运区拿东西，然后丢回本该清空的废弃飞船上。这是最后一根稻草。如果我有一个NPC船员制造这种烂摊子，我会气得把他们不穿EVA服就扔进太空。
- 角色对话很糟糕。我知道游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不符合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。战斗也一样：你必须对目标重复下达任务命令。命令顺序还会变化，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“刺”搞混。
- 微型小行星很烦人——不是因为它们存在。对于这样一个追求真实感的项目来说，它们本就该有。问题是在拆解一艘废弃飞船时，我发现自己连续修复同一个位置多达八次。撞击没有渐进式损伤：它们总是把墙+地板+电路撕到崩溃边缘，从来不会只损坏一半。
- 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。更重的“豪华”部件和更军事化的部件只是角色扮演。
- 建造应用迫切需要按类别分组零件，而不是一个长长的列表。
- 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不住自己是有110块还是210块地板件。
- 聚变反应堆物流（大型罐）真的需要管道——一个正经的泵送系统，以及从打捞来的罐中补充HE3的方法。水也一样：没有管道；你仍然要把瓶子搬到水槽。
- 零件变化相对很少。设备很多，但每件只有一个用途。你很少看到相互竞争的档次（空气泵 vs 涡轮空气泵，普通进气口 vs 海德拉进气口）。属性也很单薄：工作时与空闲时的耗电等等。
- 角色在设备或EVA服中更换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站在那里喘气。
- 你的PDA可以加一些远程控制东西的应用。我们已经有信号盒了，如果能从PDA触发它们会很棒。另外，在废弃飞船上时，你无法远程访问自己的导航站，所以即使你收到某个事件的信号，也要回到飞船“地图”才能查看任何东西。
- 考虑到用肉和打捞来的货舱能多快变富……我们需要更多不同价位的设备，或者更困难/更耗时的修理（作为交换，这需要更高的耐久度）。我上一个存档大约有560万，还没飞出OKLG——起始区域。我只是碰巧降落在一艘感染极其严重的飞船上，于是当起了屠夫。
- 还有更多我现在已经忘了的。

这是一个伟大的点子，包裹在许多小小的挫败感之中。没有什么根本性的损坏，玩起来也很有趣——直到你厌倦了与各种系统作斗争。其中很多本可以做成mod；创意工坊已经有几次尝试了。不过我感觉代码库仍在变动，所以今天能用的mod可能撑不过下一个补丁。

如果你能忍受上述问题，你会玩得很开心。我就是这样——尤其是在最初的100个小时里。之后我开始撞墙：我期望随着进度获得的自动化并不存在，而且看起来我将不得不永远微观管理一切。绝对不是浪费时间。只是有点失望。

I do really enjoy the game and can play it for hours. However, the fact that I have to make sure I save every 5-10 minutes just so I don't lose a ton of progress due to bugs or just random jank is a big issue. If they had focused on bug fixes and improving the issues that are in the content already I feel like I could recommend it more to others.

I stopped playing after logging over 100 hours due to the fire update in EA, it made the game unplayable really with the amount of issues it came with. They seem to be pushing adding more content but the base of the game is just lacking so adding the extras is just like putting glitter on dirt.

Its fine to play right now but I've already had save files corrupted and deaths due to bugs/random AI. This is during the 30 hours I have put in after release. My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on which was supposed to be fixed a while ago and storage has to all be done manually. Your items don't get registered properly whether that is during task or otherwise: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason, they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks, refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one, character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one.

Its not player friendly. It can be played but I don't think majority of gamers would enjoy this game especially not as is. It can be fun but once you get killed from your ship randomly going hyper speed for no reason it becomes annoying. If they fixed the UI and focused more on the original content I think it would be worth playing. I cant recommend it in its current state. They do do regular fixes but they also add more problems by adding more content. I haven't tried the bounty system or races because I'm not confident they even work.

Buy it if you can stand jank and slog. Otherwise stay away for a few more years until its either fully threshed out or development quits.

我真的很喜欢这款游戏，可以玩上好几个小时。然而，我必须确保每5到10分钟就保存一次，以免因为bug或随机的故障而丢失大量进度，这是个很大的问题。如果他们专注于修复bug并改进现有内容中的问题，我觉得我会更愿意推荐给别人。

在早期访问的火焰更新后，我玩了超过100小时就停止玩了，它带来的大量问题真的让游戏变得没法玩。他们似乎在推动添加更多内容，但游戏的基础本身就很欠缺，所以添加额外内容就像是在泥土上撒亮片。

现在玩起来还行，但我已经遇到过存档损坏以及因bug/随机AI导致的死亡。这是在我发布后投入的30小时里发生的。我的角色仍然会不戴头盔走进太空，这本来早就该修复了，而且存储必须全部手动完成。你的物品无法正确注册，无论是在任务中还是其他情况下：电池会无缘无故从充电器中被取出，在需要时更换电池后它们会停止做所有事情，不会重新开始任务，拒绝将物品堆叠在包里，只是一件一件地放，角色非常不可靠，我甚至无法获得其他船员，因为我在一个角色上就遇到了这些问题。

它对玩家不友好。可以玩，但我认为大多数玩家不会喜欢这款游戏，尤其是现在这个样子。它可能很有趣，但一旦你的飞船无缘无故突然超高速飞行导致你死亡，就变得很烦人。如果他们修复了UI并更专注于原有内容，我认为它值得一玩。在目前的状态下我无法推荐它。他们确实定期修复，但同时也通过添加更多内容带来了更多问题。我还没试过赏金系统或竞速，因为我不确定它们是否能正常工作。

如果你能忍受故障和苦差事就买吧。否则再等几年，直到它要么完全打磨好，要么开发停止。

I can't do this anymore. The game isn't finished, it's not even close. 

The devs added more content for 1.0, but I don't care. The base game is one of salvaging derelicts and building up your own ship, and this system BARELY WORKS. The logic involved in hauling anything you strip off a derelict is terrible. The logic for transporting items to construction is terrible.

What's the solution? Well, the astute gamer probably already guessed, MODS! Mods fix everything right? Well, the developer also decided to make native workshop support as much of a backburner issue as his core gameplay loop. After struggling with BepIn, you know, one of the most commonly used mods, and finding it impossible to get working, this is where I'm at.

I can't stand playing the intended gameplay loop anymore because of the terrible logic. I can't mod around it, despite there being MULTIPLE mods to address this GLARING oversight from the developer. I have been with this game since some of its earliest days. Every time there was a massive update, I came back to test it out, see how I liked it, and EVERY TIME I walked away going "Not ready yet, good update."

So of course when 1.0 was announced, I was very excited. It had even been a longer than average gap in playing, so I had a lot to look forward to. So you can imagine my utter disappointment when I find that the logic for hauling and construction have barely changed; aghast that my character STILL doesn't understand how to use backpacks, dollies, or COMMON SENSE FOR GODS SAKE when moving ANYTHING on my ship.

And if you're reading this review and thinking, "Surely it can't be that bad. Surely this user is just being hyperbolic." No. I'm really not. You can go and do other things, once you have money. But to get that money, you (generally) need to do the core gameloop. And by the time you really want to build up a ship, or really want to strip a derelict for all you can... you'll understand as you watch your man take a single floor tile, ignore his backpacks (which they fit in), ignore the dolly he's currently pulling, and walk ALL THE WAY to your ship to drop off ONE tile (they stack to FIVE). You'll understand.

To the dev, because I loved Neo Scavenger and I DO still believe in your vision. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ fix this. This is rediculos, and if you don't know that, you should. If you want your community to solve your terrible logic for you, then make mod integration a bigger priority. But you need to pick one and fix this. I don't care about any other content you add to the game until this is resolved. Period.

我再也受不了了。这游戏根本没做完，差得远呢。

开发者给1.0加了更多内容，但我不在乎。基础玩法就是打捞废弃飞船、建造自己的飞船，而这套系统几乎没法用。搬运从废弃飞船上拆下来的任何东西，其逻辑都糟糕透顶。把物品运到建造处的逻辑也糟糕透顶。

那解决办法是什么？机灵的玩家大概已经猜到了，MOD！MOD能解决一切，对吧？可开发者偏偏把原生创意工坊支持也当成核心玩法循环一样，扔到最不重要的位置。在跟BepIn——你知道的，最常用的MOD之一——折腾半天，发现根本没法让它跑起来之后，我就卡在这儿了。

因为那糟糕的逻辑，我再也受不了按设计好的玩法循环去玩了。我也没法用MOD绕开它，尽管有多个MOD专门针对开发者这个刺眼的疏漏。我从这游戏很早的时候就一直跟着它。每次有大更新，我都会回来试试，看看自己喜不喜欢，而每一次我离开时都说‘还没准备好，更新不错’。

所以当1.0宣布时，我当然非常兴奋。而且距离上次玩已经隔了比平时更久，所以有很多值得期待的东西。于是你可以想象我有多失望：搬运和建造的逻辑几乎没变；我有多震惊：我的角色在船上搬任何东西时，居然还是不懂怎么用背包、手推车，或者他妈的常识。

如果你读这篇评测时心想：‘不可能那么糟吧。这用户肯定是在夸张。’不。我真没有。有钱之后你可以去干别的。但要拿到钱，你（通常）就得跑核心玩法循环。而等你真想造一艘飞船，或者真想尽可能拆光一艘废弃飞船时……你就会明白了，你会看着你的角色拿起一块地板砖，无视他的背包（明明装得下），无视他正拉着的手推车，然后一路走回你的飞船，就为了放下一块砖（它们能叠到五块）。你就会明白了。

致开发者：因为我爱《Neo Scavenger》，而且我仍然相信你的构想。他妈的把这修好。这太荒唐了，如果你不知道，那你该知道。如果你想让你的社区替你解决这糟糕的逻辑，那就把MOD整合当成更优先的事。但你必须二选一，把这修好。在这解决之前，你往游戏里加什么其他内容我都不在乎。就这样。

I tried a session years ago (around 5 hrs). UI gave some problems, so I decided to put it off, until they finished the game. Well, it's 1.0, another 5 hrs, and oh boy.

While some of the UI issues have gotten better, UI is still illegible in many ways. Why are some items "pristine" and others not?  It obviously isn't item durability, as I have seen pristine items that have been torn apart down to 30% or less. Repairing it to full, 100% doesn't make it either. No rhyme or reason. Then there is how little oversight one has over what each stat does, what your traits do, what your skills do, etc. Sure I can see that over time I do repairs quicker, I install and uninstall items quicker, after some time. But there is nothing telling me why that is. If not for the wiki, I would have no clue what "security threshold" even means.

Speaking of the wiki, it felt like a shot in the nuts, when I discovered that a 1.0 game has so little variety. Ok, you upgrade from a screwdriver to a power tool. What's next? This is 50 years in the future. The one upgrade path, that is somewhat fully developed is the one that is about structure cutting. You go from a hacksaw, to an angle grinder, to a laser torch. Everything else? 2 or even just 1 tool only. The PDA neglect is the worst part of it. There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around, depending on what you need to be able to see at that moment. These are just the tools you use directly.  

What about the ship? You use the same nav console that EVERYONE USES. There is only one. You use the exact same thruster, so on and so forth. There are only two items that actually have some variety: sensors and floors/walls. You are able to choose from around 10 sensors and there are, what feels like, over 40+ floor tiles. You also get some choice in clothing (which doesn't matter, because you spend so much time doing EVA anyways, thus you aren't seeing it). To be clear, this wouldn't be an issue, if everyone item wasn't branded with a manufacturer label. Rimworlod has one console and nobody cares. But when you have "Polaris "Standard Navigation Console" Nav Station" as your nav console, well then suddenly it becomes a question of why nobody else is in that business.  There are multiple tool businesses, why not multiple nav consoles?

Overall game progression feels grindy and tedious, while also being rather straightforward and linear. Would not recommend.

我几年前试玩过一次（大约5小时）。UI出了一些问题，所以我决定推迟，等他们完成游戏再说。好吧，现在是1.0版，又玩了5小时，我的天哪。

虽然一些UI问题有所改善，但UI在很多方面仍然难以辨认。为什么有些物品是“完好”的，而另一些不是？这显然不是物品耐久度，因为我见过被拆解到30%或更低的完好物品。把它修到满，100%也不行。毫无规律可言。然后是对每个属性做什么、你的特质做什么、你的技能做什么等等，几乎没有监督。当然，我能看到随着时间推移，我修理得更快，安装和卸载物品也更快。但没有任何东西告诉我为什么。如果不是因为wiki，我根本不知道“安全阈值”是什么意思。

说到wiki，当我发现一个1.0游戏的变化如此之少时，感觉就像蛋上挨了一枪。好吧，你从螺丝刀升级到电动工具。接下来呢？这是50年后的未来。唯一一条某种程度上完整开发的升级路径，是关于结构切割的那条。你从钢锯，到角磨机，再到激光炬。其他一切呢？只有2个甚至只有1个工具。对PDA的忽视是最糟糕的部分。有多个卡带，你本应能够插入。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能根据当时需要看到什么而不断切换。这些还只是你直接使用的工具。

那飞船呢？你使用的是每个人都使用的同一个导航控制台。只有一个。你使用完全相同的推进器，等等等等。只有两样物品真正有一些变化：传感器和地板/墙壁。你可以从大约10种传感器中选择，还有感觉超过40多种的地板砖。你在服装上也有一些选择（这无关紧要，因为你花那么多时间做EVA，所以你看不到它）。说清楚点，如果每件物品没有都贴上制造商标签，这不会是个问题。Rimworld有一个控制台，没人在乎。但当你的导航控制台是“Polaris‘标准导航控制台’导航站”时，好吧，那突然就变成了为什么没有其他公司做这个生意的问题。有多个工具企业，为什么不能有多个导航控制台？

整体游戏进程感觉既肝又乏味，同时还相当直接和线性。不推荐。

Before I start, I've been a big fan of Blue Bottle Games, remembering back when I was a kid and playing NeoScavenger. It's a great game, one that I plan to play through and actually beat now that I'm older. I don't think that game can really be improved upon. So, good work! Understand that I'm not coming at this from a malicious angle, I'm just disappointed that you slapped a 1.0 sticker on it despite it not being remotely complete.

Originally I wasn't going to write this review, but after seeing a few other reviews, I think I'll weigh in. Especially since one of the reviewers was banned from the Steam forums for this game, then muted on Discord for trying to discuss the game's issues because he wasn't stating "facts."

[hr][/hr]

[b]Here's the facts, Blue Bottle Games.[/b]

Your game is broken, it's as simple as that. Not broken as in bottom line unplayable, but broken through attrition, these bugs stack together to make the experience unbearable over time.

[b]The EVA Suit Glitch[/b]
One of the bugs I can prove: if your game autosaves the moment your EVA suit breaks, the game still thinks you're wearing it. Put on a new EVA suit, and now the game thinks you're wearing TWO, doubling your slowdown. This bug has apparently existed for years with no fix. I worked around it personally using the givecond console command to force my skill to max so it's more bearable, but the game still tracks it as a skill based penalty, meaning I still suffer a 50% penalty even with a real EVA suit on when heading into the void.

This game is, in no way, in a 1.0 state. I haven't reached the outer planets yet, but from what I understand and have read online, they're just placeholders, copies of stations you've already visited. How is that 1.0?

[b]Crew & Management Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] The management system itself is clunky and poorly implemented.
[*] There's a battery glitch that was stated to be fixed, and was for an hour, but broke again. Once a crewmember swaps a battery, they just drop it on the ground instead of storing it.
[*] Install a treadmill or any workout machine, and crew will use it even while smelly, tired, or needing to handle social needs during downtime. The bigger the crew, the more micromanagement this creates as I don't want all my water gone from random times in which they decide to clean up, and that's IF they decide to clean up. Often, I find myself forcing them to clean themselves so they get less depressed, only to have to do it again because they keep running on that treadmill.
[*] Crew sometimes won't auto do tasks even with the option enabled. Example: I airlock onto a derelict ship to disassemble walls, floors, and conduits. Despite being scheduled, they'll use that STUPID treadmill instead of working. You have to manually assign them, send them out, then re-enable auto task.
[/list]

Yes, I understand the roster system. Yes, they have the right equipment, charged batteries, filled O2 tanks, helmets on. Yes, they're cleared to do everything. This isn't a misunderstanding of the game's mechanics on my part. It's a failure on your part to make crew reliably search for jobs to do.

[b]"Realism"[/b]
[list]
[*] You just launched a bounty system with no convenient or realistic way to subdue or incapacitate NPCs for extended periods. This is especially frustrating since some bounty targets are required alive.
[*] You can put shoes on the wrong feet, with no visual cue for which shoe goes where other than the description. Both shoes visually display as "right" or "left" boots despite not actually being so I'm blanking which direction they face at the moment, but if I remember correctly, they all face left.
[/list]

Very realistic, ty.
But what really bothers me most as a longtime fan is your disregard for people clearly raising issues, like me, and then silencing them. It's a shame, and it's beneath you as a whole.

[hr][/hr]

TL;DR:

Don't get the game, it's been six years into development, people with concerns are being silenced, and it's riddled with bugs that eventually break your game rendering unplayable. 
Also, for some reason, a single save can get as big as a gigabyte, idk why.

在我开始之前，我一直是Blue Bottle Games的忠实粉丝，还记得小时候玩NeoScavenger的时光。那是一款很棒的游戏，现在我长大了，打算把它通关并真正打败它。我认为那款游戏真的无法再改进了。所以，干得好！请理解我并不是出于恶意，我只是很失望，尽管游戏远未完成，你们却给它贴上了1.0的标签。

本来我不打算写这篇评测，但在看了其他几篇评测后，我想我也该发表一下意见。尤其是因为其中一位评测者因为试图讨论游戏的问题而被这个游戏的Steam论坛封禁，然后又在Discord上被禁言，理由是他没有陈述“事实”。

[hr][/hr]

[b]以下是事实，Blue Bottle Games。[/b]

你们的游戏是坏的，就这么简单。不是说底线意义上的无法游玩，而是被消耗性地损坏，这些bug叠加在一起，随着时间推移让体验变得无法忍受。

[b]EVA宇航服故障[/b]
我可以证明的一个bug：如果你的游戏在你的EVA宇航服损坏的那一刻自动保存，游戏仍然认为你穿着它。穿上一件新的EVA宇航服，现在游戏认为你穿着两件，让你的减速效果翻倍。这个bug显然已经存在多年，一直没有修复。我个人通过使用givecond控制台命令强制把我的技能调到最高来绕过它，这样稍微好受一些，但游戏仍然将其作为基于技能的惩罚来追踪，这意味着即使穿着真正的EVA宇航服进入虚空时，我仍然承受50%的惩罚。

这款游戏绝无可能处于1.0状态。我还没有到达外行星，但据我了解和在网上读到的内容，它们只是占位符，是你已经访问过的空间站的复制品。这怎么能算1.0？

[b]船员与管理问题[/b]
[list]
[*] 管理系统本身笨拙且实现得很差。
[*] 有一个电池故障，据称已修复，也确实修复了一个小时，但又坏了。一旦船员更换电池，他们就直接把电池扔在地上，而不是存放起来。
[*] 安装一台跑步机或任何健身器材，船员会在休息时间使用它，即使他们身上发臭、疲惫或需要处理社交需求。船员越多，这造成的微观管理就越多，因为我不想因为他们在随机时间决定清理而把水都用光，而且那还是在他们决定清理的情况下。我经常发现自己强迫他们清洁自己以减少抑郁，结果又得再来一次，因为他们一直在那台跑步机上跑步。
[*] 即使启用了选项，船员有时也不会自动执行任务。例如：我通过气闸进入一艘废弃飞船去拆解墙壁、地板和管道。尽管已经排好日程，他们却会使用那台愚蠢的跑步机而不是工作。你必须手动分配他们，把他们送出去，然后重新启用自动任务。
[/list]

是的，我理解花名册系统。是的，他们有合适的装备、充满电的电池、装满的氧气罐、戴着头盔。是的，他们被批准做所有事情。这不是我对游戏机制的误解。这是你们的失败，没能让船员可靠地寻找要做的工作。

[b]“真实感”[/b]
[list]
[*] 你们刚刚推出了一个赏金系统，却没有方便或现实的方法来长时间制服或使NPC失去行动能力。这尤其令人沮丧，因为有些赏金目标需要活捉。
[*] 你可以把鞋子穿错脚，除了描述之外没有任何视觉提示表明哪只鞋该穿哪只脚。两只鞋在视觉上都显示为“右”或“左”靴子，尽管实际上并非如此，我一时想不起来它们朝哪个方向，但如果我记得没错的话，它们都朝左。
[/list]

非常真实，谢谢。
但作为一个长期粉丝，最让我困扰的是你们对像我这样明确提出问题的人的漠视，然后让他们噤声。这是一种耻辱，有失你们整体的身份。

别买这个游戏，它已经开发了六年，有顾虑的人被噤声，而且它充满了bug，最终会破坏你的游戏，使其无法游玩。

У Ostranauts огромный потенциал, концепция космического бомжа-утилизатора реально затягивает. Но техническая сторона сейчас — это тихий ужас. Чем дольше идет одна игровая сессия, тем сильнее всё ломается. Начинают вылезать бесконечные ошибки, намертво пропадает интерфейс, а некоторые действия персонажей просто перестают работать.

[*]Абсолютно тупой ИИ экипажа. Напарники постоянно творят дичь. Стоит включить высокую скорость времени, как они банально забывают надевать шлем от скафандра и просто задыхаются.
[/list]

items.text:
Before I start this review I want to say that I dont think this game is passionless slop.

Ostranauts is a game which I sunk 14 hours into a playthrough for, with more hours in total from pirated copies. Yet ive really not seen anything too interesting, which is weird. Instead ive spent a bunch of time watching my character uninstall some scrap. Then dragging it back to my ugly (im aware it makes sense in universe but its still true) ship, flying back to a station, and selling it. I really dont have anything too interesting to spend my money on so I just put it back into my mortgage.

And thats a problem because scrapping ships seems to be the main gameplay element in this game. Yet its boring, at least its boring for the first 14 HOURS, none of which was spent fiddling with any controls. I never encountered a ship where there was, I dont know, crazy cultists, haywire defense systems, aliens, parasites, ANYTHING. Not even a room that was pressurized and so opening it will pull air in and hurt me. Oh, its a nuclear reactor, clearly uninstalling this unprepared will kill me, right? Nope, I just right click, press uninstall, and thats it. 

Thats what you do to everything, right click, press uninstall, some items can get damaged by uninstalling (like transponders) so clearly I need to prepare more and uninstall it more care- nope, its just rng, you just save scum it. Literally everything behaves the exact same and its so dull. Keep in mind im anxious as all heck, if there were one singular instance of ANYTHING happening id be scared for the rest of my playthrough.

This is related to the biggest thing lacking in this game, atmosphere. At least while on the vessels you are intended to scrap, theres nothing. The sound design is uninteresting. you never hear the ship creaking and threatening to break apart. You hear nothing. Sure it might be realistic but who cares about realism, realism serves to make the gameplay more involved or interesting, not to strip back interesting elements (insert the todd howard saying "oh starfield is realistic IRL you woudnt find anything on random planets).

The game is dystopian in name only. What happens when I dock, surely some guy holds me up for two hours unless I have money or "know someone", right? Nope, you dock perfectly fine with no holdups. Okay but clearly someones going to hold my ship hostage and make me pay a fee, right? Nope. You get charged very reasonable docking fees. You buy salvage passes to make sure you are legally allowed to salvage. So at some point a cop is going to run around and demand your salvage pass before tearing it up and saying that he will do you a favour and let you off this time (for a small fee, of course.) Nope. If you have a salvage pass no one bugs you.

Alright, so maybe not the corruption angle, maybe just the corporate greed angle (clearly something the game wants you to think). So I should start the game with just like, INSURMOUNTABLE amounts of debt from the corpos but nope, just your mortgage. When I fly back I should just be saddled with INSANE tacked on fees, fees for convenience, fees for administrative slop, fees that arent actually for anything. so on and so on. I'm not even being creative, thats just IRL ticketmaster. IRL ticketmaster is more of a dystopia than the fictional videogame. 

Also theres an achievement named 16 tons, and you get it from getting scrip, I dont have it. Why dont I have it. Scrip should really, be the DEFAULT METHOD of payment, the company store should be trying to OWN ME. Yet I get payed in normal legal tender I can use anywhere. Like whats the point.

This is all to say that despite the fact ostronauts claims to be a dystopian society, it really isnt, like theres really NOTHING dystopian here, other than some small annoying fees, sometimes. Like cmon, be a dystopia, not just like, capitalism but honestly less bad than right now for the most part.

Yeah sure maybe the game gets more interesting when you invest the time into building a torch reactor and flying far. But thats just annoying. The shipbuilding in this game is annoying and you have very little in game motivation to buypass it. You click to place where floors and walls should be and watch as your guy SLOWLY places them. Then if you would want that room to be survivable you need to install air and N2 and heating and cooling and all of that tied to thermostats and Blah Blah Blah. Its annoying and boring, and before you say "oh you just dont like building spacecraft" and true enough its not my favourite thing but at the same time ive played a large amount of KSP and enjoyed it. If this game just had an ACTUAL ship editor where I can place down what I want and I get an itemized list of what im missing this system would be WAAAY better. Also let me buy more floors and walls. 

You can just say "oh you have no patience" and sure, I don't. I've also put hundreds of hours into My Summer Car, a game that advertises itself as "not fun" I love stalker gamma, a game where getting a new weapon WILL take hours. I've played stalker mods that are extremely slow. But I enjoyed them because they gave me unique experiences, stories. The story of the brain scorcher raid. The story of me winning the rally. The story of me completing one quest (looking at you NLC 7, no one will no what that is). This game has given me one story (for like 99% of my playtime)

The story of docking with a ship, pressing right click to uninstall, and dragging it back.

Sure theres gigs and bounties, I BUILT MY ENTIRE CURRENT CHARACTER AROUND DOING THEM but they still just serve as supplementary income. Not to mention bounties are just, broken, you just show me a ship with no location info. I really cant do anything with this, apparently according to a guide I install a radar and sort through like, 100 ships, like really, is that exciting? 

Overall, ostronauts is tedious, boring, and not worth playing for most people. Thumbs down, I do not recommend
items.text_zh:
在我开始这篇评测之前，我想说我不认为这款游戏是没有热情的垃圾。

Ostranauts 是一款我投入了14个小时进行一周目游玩的游戏，加上盗版副本的总时长还要更多。然而我真的没看到任何太有趣的东西，这很奇怪。相反，我花了一大堆时间看着我的角色拆卸一些废料。然后把它拖回我那丑陋的（我知道这在世界观里说得通，但它确实很丑）飞船，飞回空间站，然后卖掉它。我真的没有什么太有趣的东西可以花钱，所以我只能把它又投回我的抵押贷款里。

而这是个问题，因为拆解飞船似乎是这款游戏的主要玩法元素。但它很无聊，至少在前14个小时里很无聊，这期间我完全没有摆弄过任何控制装置。我从未遇到过一艘有，我不知道，疯狂邪教徒、失控防御系统、外星人、寄生虫，任何东西的飞船。甚至连一个加压的房间都没有，打开它会让空气涌入并伤到我。哦，这是核反应堆，显然毫无准备地拆卸它会杀了我，对吧？不，我只是右键点击，按下拆卸，就这样。

你对所有东西都是这么做的，右键点击，按下拆卸，有些物品在拆卸时可能会损坏（比如应答器），所以显然我需要做更多准备，更小心地拆卸它——不，这只是随机数，你只要存档读档就行了。字面意义上的所有东西行为都完全一样，而且太乏味了。记住我焦虑得要命，如果哪怕有任何一个瞬间发生了任何事情，我都会在剩下的游玩过程中一直害怕。

这与这款游戏最缺乏的东西有关，氛围。至少在你打算拆解的飞船上时，什么都没有。音效设计毫无趣味。你永远听不到飞船吱嘎作响、威胁要散架。你什么都听不到。当然这也许很真实，但谁在乎真实，真实是为了让玩法更投入或更有趣，而不是剥离有趣的元素（插入托德·霍华德说“哦《星空》很真实，在现实中你在随机星球上什么都找不到”）。

items.text:
Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. I like the concept of it - starting with a small ship in mortgage, access to a ship boneyard for a nominal fee (or for free if you're good at hiding from cops) and some skills in building ships and tearing them apart. Simulated electrical systems, pressure, malfunctions such as fires or navigation station software bugging out. Build out your ship, travel the Solar System, do some stuff - questing, trading, asteriod mining, even participating in a war, good stuff, good ideas.

The problem is bad implementation. The deeper you go into the game, the more problems you find with various systems. The gases don't go through adiabatic cooling, which is reasonable for a game, so any gases you pump into your ship are at room temperature, but *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot. Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on (space, remember?). Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways that are too long to go into details here. Barely anything happens during time skip, so if you want any work done, you'll have to let your characters do the work and go watch Youtube or something. Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers. And speaking of tools, they will choose the first tool they find when you need one, not "the best in their inventory" or anything like that, so you need to take care to not leave old tools in any reachable places. CO2 filters never get used up, so while CO2 buildup is still bad for your character, that particular system is half-baked. Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane.

Flight is Newtonian... to a point, it doesn't simulate gravity faithfully enough (in my opinion) and the navigation station doesn't give you enough tools to utilize the fact. Fuel isn't accounted in ship mass, which you could argue is a gameplay decision, but cargo in cargo pods does count in ship mass, so I dunno. Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes.

I could go on and on, but you get the idea. I have two problems with this game. I played this game for 250 hours total, about 150 hours back when I just bought it and about 100 hours near and after release. This game pulled me in enough that I tried to figure out and work around all this problems, be it by modding, adapting my processes to the s*** factor, or any other ways. But at some point my will just broke. This game is an exercise in frustration, and in the end frustration subsumes any amount of enjoyment I got out of this game. The game is full of bugs, Discord bug forum is full of bugs, and only a small amount of them gets acknowledged and even smaller about fixed. The devs say "report the bugs", but even after you report it *and provide source code for a mod that fixes it*, chances are the bug will stay in the game for weeks ahead. I don't have patience to wait for months, but some well-known problems have stayed for years, apparently, so make what you will of it. That's the first and the biggest problem. The second, as the dev's community manager eloquently put it in Discord, "this game's elevator pitch is Firefly episode generator". There is a reason I'm indifferent to Firefly as opposed to Star Trek, and it's the setting. This game won't tell you power draw or any other specs for spaceship equipment. It won't tell you how much thrust thrusters produce or how far sensors can detect things. You're supposed to wing it. I don't like it.

By the way, I like Rimworld. Rimworld is also a "story generator". It's also a lot, lot, lot better implementation-wise than this game. Don't get fooled by comparison.

So there it is. Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out. Maybe this is not a one-guy-or-small-team-flying-spaceship simulation game but a dating simulator in space with elements of shipbuilding? I dunno. If you want to get the game, make absolutely sure your expectations match what it is.

遗憾的是，我无法凭良心推荐这款游戏。我喜欢它的概念——从一艘还在按揭的小船开始，可以花点小钱（或者如果你擅长躲警察就免费）进入飞船坟场，还有一些建造和拆解飞船的技能。模拟电气系统、压力、火灾或导航站软件故障等故障。建造你的飞船，在太阳系中旅行，做些事情——任务、贸易、小行星采矿，甚至参与战争，好东西，好想法。

问题在于糟糕的实现。你在游戏中越深入，就会发现各种系统的问题越多。气体不会经历绝热冷却，这对游戏来说还算合理，所以你泵入飞船的任何气体都是室温的，但*有时候*给房间重新加压后，它却只有几开尔文的温度。角色倾向于选择绕飞船的路，如果可能的话，不管那条路是否会通到外面，而他们又没穿EVA服（太空，记得吗？）。自动任务分配，如果你不想一个个点击角色安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上就是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕，细节太长这里就不展开了。时间跳过期间几乎什么都不会发生，所以如果你想完成任何工作，你就得让角色干活，自己去看YouTube什么的。角色仍然无法更换工具里的电池，而是把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器。说到工具，当你需要一个工具时，他们会选择找到的第一个工具，而不是“他们库存中最好的”之类的，所以你得小心，不要把旧工具留在任何可触及的地方。CO2过滤器永远不会用完，所以虽然CO2积累对你的角色仍然有害，但那个特定系统是半生不熟的。售货亭里买卖物品的分类方式神秘莫测。

飞行是牛顿式的……到一定程度，它（在我看来）没有足够忠实地模拟重力，导航站也没有给你足够的工具来利用这一事实。燃料不计入飞船质量，你可以说这是游戏性决定，但货舱里的货物确实计入飞船质量，所以我不知道。行星际旅行的自动驾驶作弊，使用过多燃料，有时还会把你撞进行星。

我可以继续说下去，但你明白意思了。我对这款游戏有两个问题。我总共玩了250小时，大约150小时是我刚买的时候，大约100小时是在发布前后。这款游戏足够吸引我，以至于我试图弄清楚并绕过所有这些问题，无论是通过模组、调整我的流程来适应这坨屎，还是其他方式。但到了某个时候，我的意志就崩溃了。这款游戏是一场挫折的练习，最终挫折感吞没了我从中获得的任何乐趣。游戏充满bug，Discord的bug论坛充满bug，只有一小部分被承认，被修复的就更少了。开发者说“报告bug”，但即使你报告了*并且提供了修复它的模组源代码*，这个bug很可能还会在游戏中停留数周。我没有耐心等几个月，但一些众所周知的问题显然已经存在多年了，所以你自己看着办吧。这是第一个也是最大的问题。第二个，正如开发者的社区经理在Discord上雄辩地说的，“这款
游戏的电梯游说是“萤火虫剧集生成器”。我对《萤火虫》不像对《星际迷航》那样感兴趣是有原因的，那就是它的设定。这款游戏不会告诉你飞船设备的功耗或任何其他规格。它不会告诉你推进器产生多少推力，或者传感器能探测到多远的东西。你应该自己随机应变。我不喜欢这样。

顺便说一句，我喜欢《环世界》。《环世界》也是一个“故事生成器”。在实现方面，它也比这款游戏好得多得多得多。别被这种比较骗了。

所以就是这样。显然，这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等有深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，所以我干脆忽略了它。就像这款游戏的常态一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你应该自己去弄明白。也许这不是一个单人或小团队驾驶飞船的模拟游戏，而是一个带有造船元素的太空约会模拟器？我不知道。如果你想买这款游戏，一定要绝对确保你的期望与它的实际内容相符。

items.text:
Such a good simulation and concept, let down by the fact that devs forgot this is supposed to be a game and desperately needs some QoL and gamification, examples:

[list]
    [*]Salvage timescale - Often you'll be salvaging/repairing and be manually speeding up to 16x, pausing as you finish so you don't waste time before repeating the cycle on the next piece of equipment.  Order systems helps for hull and conduit but when working on equipment it should auto speed and slow as finished.
    [*]Character Creation - Very cool system, but if you don't pick EVA and Mechanical you're going to have a bad time engaging the main early game loop of salvaging, making character creation somewhat bland.
    [*]Docking - Should have an autodock module in the nav that can eventually be bought!, exists in the workshop and would be great as an early automation goal. Even earlier could have a dockign request button vs. the current hail ship, hail again, pick dock that goes on.
    [*]Ship Editor in-game - Customising the startership feels great early game but is a slog for torch drive rooms, watching my guy for 10min at max speed just drag floors and walls around. Really needs to be drydock where I can pay a docking fee or repair fee, make the ship with an editor from parts I have then have it simulate time passing as the ship gets built up by me or the dock.
    [*]More accessible gameplay loops - It's quite a slog to go from the initial salvage gameplay loop to other ones because the torch drive and tanks needs a beast of a ship making going to hubs for bounty hunting, mining impactical. Game also gets a bit stale since salvaging is almost all there is to do until you get the torch drive.
[/list]

如此出色的模拟和概念，却因为开发者忘了这应该是一款游戏而令人失望，并且迫切需要一些生活质量和游戏化方面的改进，例如：

[list]
    [*]打捞时间尺度——你经常会一边打捞/修理，一边手动加速到16倍，完成时暂停以免浪费时间，然后在下一件设备上重复这个循环。订单系统对船体和管道有帮助，但在处理设备时，它应该在完成时自动加速和减速。
    [*]角色创建——非常酷的系统，但如果你不选EVA和机械，你在参与早期主要打捞循环时会很痛苦，这让角色创建显得有些乏味。
    [*]对接——导航中应该有一个最终可以购买的自动对接模块！创意工坊里已经有了，作为早期自动化目标会很棒。更早的话，可以有一个对接请求按钮，而不是现在的呼叫船只、再次呼叫、选择对接这一套流程。
    [*]游戏内飞船编辑器——早期游戏时自定义起始飞船感觉很棒，但对于火炬驱动室来说很费劲，看着我的角色以最高速度花10分钟只是拖拽地板和墙壁。真的需要一个干船坞，我可以在那里支付停靠费或修理费，用我拥有的部件通过编辑器造出飞船，然后让它模拟时间流逝，由我或船坞把飞船建造起来。
    [*]更易接触的游戏循环——从最初的打捞游戏循环过渡到其他循环相当费劲，因为火炬驱动和燃料罐需要一艘巨兽般的飞船，使得前往枢纽进行赏金狩猎、采矿变得不切实际。游戏也会变得有点乏味，因为在获得火炬驱动之前，打捞几乎是唯一能做的事。
[/list]

The idea of the game is great, i supported with early access a long ago and I returned to it with every major milestone, but very disappointed in 1.0
The problems are: there are too many things that do not work as intended or are just plain bugs.
The core loop, at the start at least, is
- find ship -> disassemble ship -> sell parts -> complain that you don't have money -> repeat

BUT
- the automated commands for disassemble, build and haul to hangar zones do not work well
> they are laggy
> they are buggy: you unistall a wall that had a power conduit in it? If you give the command Haul restricted to electrical things, the wall gets hauled in the elettrical zone of your hangar too. And so it's with a lot of other things
- After the first one or two ships you have to use the automation IA of the characters to do things, but it's simply crap as:
> it prioritize things in a non easy to undestarnd way, and there is no control over its priorities
> it's buggy: it get stuck doing the same things, it takes in game minutes to figure out what to do

Then also: it's a sci-fi building / exploring game and you have to manage your resources and keep track of items... but there is no way of knowing things like
> My ship consumes 70W, ok: which part is draining power, how can I manage that? i cannot know, and the simple answer is just power down thing MANUALLY when you dont need them. 
I'm building a spaceship, but i don't get basic logic circuits to manage it.

Like: i'm docket at port -> power down air systems or navigation or whatever.
The Fun would be building those systems and see them work or fail. If you give building capabilities then... you have to have them, you cant just have a middle ground.

I really hope they improve this basic mechanics as they really bug the the whole game which is good

items.text:
I've been following and playing Ostranauts through years of EA and I'm pleased that is now officially released.

I'm a game developer myself and I often like to play games to see new ideas and new mechanics - this game is full of really interesting ideas.

The progression from - how am I ever going to progress to slowly building up your knowledge of the game, your equipment, your ship, making a good find and the realistic feel of the world is very worthwhile.

It has a lot of things to like:
- interesting character creation scenarios
- awesome derelicts to explore
- meaningful scrapping
- fun encounters
- interesting social dynamics
- feels impactful when you talk yourself out of situations like bribing the authorities
- a nicely thought out world

I have not come close to finishing the game - just a few scrapping runs, travelling between a few stations and some in-game socializing.
Though I wanted to give the game a thumbs up.

Some things that would make it better:
- more choice over the initial ship
- visual spaceflight for ship travel - I would prefer full joystick-like movement - though it would at least be better if there was a viewport showing your progress than just essentially a 2D vector plot
- the inventory management on the characters and the ship
- the uninstalling, installing and fixing can drag on - though it deepens your immersion into the world

Note that I just play as a single NPC and I haven't been hiring crew / adding AIs.

It has a bit of jankiness that rankle me as a developer - though I feel I am more than getting my money's worth.

items.text:
Ostranauts is definitely not easy to recommend in its current state as of 1.0.  It's got jank and a lot of half-baked features, but the hard sci-fi elements of salvaging, building and piloting ships around the solar system is fun enough.  Traveling long distances feels equally rewarding and risky, as lack of preparation, improper planning or a piloting mistake will leave you stranded.  That said, you'll probably get a more complete experience if you wait a while for more patches to be added and mods to be developed.

Here a few things that I dislike about the current state of the game:

-NPC interactions.  I like the idea, but interacting with NPCs is just bland at the surface level once you understand the minigame.  There is hardly any unique dialogue outside of the rather few story missions.
-Speaking of missions, NPCs will randomly ask you, a seemingly complete stranger, to do a task for them that involves finding someone, talking to them (beating them up first being optional sometimes), and then traveling back.  The "someone to find" is random and sometimes on a completely different planetary body, or in my case, driving a police patrol craft in deep space 1.2 AU from Ganymede, where they should have been stationed.  Oh, and there is no reward for these, so I'm not really sure what the point is.  (The actual story missions are neat, but few and far between.)
-Lack of ship VFX.  We're under thrust using a torch drive burning at 4gs spinward, yet ships have no visible drive plumes.
-Stats of ship components are not visible anywhere.  For example, the mass and durability of walls and floors vary based on the manufacturer, but this isn't listed anywhere in-game and cannot be viewed outside of obtaining a mass scanner plugin for your PDA, which you probably won't find until you've already added on to your ship.  This applies to basically every electronic item in the game too.
-NPC crew member controls.  During scheduled work time, NPCs will often ignore orders and just do whatever the hell they want.  The only way I could get them to stop "studying" on the computer I installed in the break room was to unplug it during working hours.  Also there needs to be global orders you can quickly give that override other activities, such as "emergency repairs" and "secure for maneuvering" (to you know, get in a crash couch before they are crushed to death.)
-Lack of advanced hauling/bartering zone controls to let you specify exactly where items should be stored, and for NPCs to actually haul items to be stored there.  Currently, if I purchase scrap, it ends up in my fridge, even though the fridge is set as a "food only" zone.  The opposite happens too.  
-Physics simulation is a little too simple.  It doesn't matter where you put your thrusters or where your center of mass is, the ship behaves the same regardless.  Aerodynamics is determined entirely by mass and how many heavy lift rotors and aerodynamic hull parts you have, not necessarily the shape of the ship.  There is no explosive decompression, and atmospheric flight using heavy lift rotors needs a pass.  (Specifically, you have to have an even number of clockwise and counter-clockwise spinning heavy lift rotors, otherwise you get stuck in a death spin.  There is no way to change direction other than unpowering and repowering them.)
-Inventory is just weird.  You have a space suit, but no specially designed bag to carry stuff around in while in a space suit, so your character has to occupy a hand by dragging around a backpack permanently.
-No way to automate putting on/taking off a suit.  Until a person spends enough time in a space suit (upwards of a month from what I can tell), they suffer a severe work speed penalty.
-Lack of proper airlocks.  You're always briefly leaking atmos when crew enter/leave the ship because airlocks are effectively two doors put a few feet apart, with no way to "cycle" airlocks.
-Lack of crew retention and benefits.  Crew are paid a pathetic amount daily.  You could be bringing in millions in a trade run, but they're only getting $250.  Micromanage them too hard or don't meet one of their needs (which are somewhat obfuscated), and they'll just up and quit on you, and there is no way to give them a higher salary until they decide to quit.  A way to reward hard work (because crew do slack off)/match their pay to the skills they've developed since joining, and maybe even a healthcare plan to automate the treating those nasty blisters they got when your ship suddenly lost pressure and their skin boiled would be a really nice addition.

These are just to name a few, and thankfully, there are a few mods that can cover some half-baked features and IMO should be included in the full game:

"Ship's Water" - A mod that adds water tanks, showers, waste water storage/processing and the ability to bulk purchase water.  Otherwise, you're filling up bottles in slowly recharging sinks on stations, or tediously buying containers of it.  Crew need to drink and bathe with water with or without this mod, but this makes managing water much less tedious. This is seriously a "must have" mod.

"Uninstall and Haul" - In Vanilla, when you first dock with a wreck, you can run through and mark anything you want to salvage in-tact with an "uninstall" order.  Unfortunately, you will then have to order it to be "hauled" back to your ship after the component was uninstalled.  This mod adds a combined order that will save you a ton of time and needless tedium.
items.text_zh:
就1.0版本目前的状况而言，《Ostranauts》绝对不容易推荐。它有不少毛病和大量半生不熟的功能，但在太阳系各处打捞、建造和驾驶飞船这些硬科幻元素还是足够有趣的。长途旅行既让人感到有回报又充满风险，因为准备不足、计划不当或驾驶失误都会让你被困在途中。话虽如此，如果你等上一段时间，等更多补丁加入、模组开发出来，你可能会获得更完整的体验。

以下是我不喜欢游戏当前状态的一些地方：

-NPC互动。我喜欢这个想法，但一旦你理解了这个小游戏，与NPC互动在表面层面上就显得平淡无奇。除了相当少的故事任务之外，几乎没有任何独特的对话。
-说到任务，NPC会随机要求你——一个看似完全陌生的人——为他们做一项任务，包括找到某人、与他们交谈（有时可以先揍他们一顿，这是可选的），然后再返回。那个“要找的人”是随机的，有时在一个完全不同的行星体上，或者就我的情况而言，在距离木卫三1.2天文单位的深空中驾驶一艘警察巡逻艇，而他们本该驻扎在那里。哦，而且这些任务没有奖励，所以我真不太确定意义何在。（实际的故事任务很不错，但少而间隔很远。）
-缺乏飞船视觉特效。我们正在使用火炬驱动器以4g的加速度向旋进方向推进，但飞船却没有可见的驱动尾焰。
-飞船部件的属性在任何地方都看不到。例如，墙壁和地板的重量和耐久度因制造商而异，但这在游戏内任何地方都没有列出，除非为你的PDA获得一个质量扫描插件，否则无法查看，而你很可能在已经给飞船加建之后才会找到它。这基本上也适用于游戏中的每一件电子物品。
-NPC船员控制。在预定的工作时间，NPC经常会无视命令，想干什么就干什么。我唯一能让他们停止在我安装在休息室的电脑上“学习”的办法，就是在工作时间里拔掉电脑电源。此外还需要可以快速下达、覆盖其他活动的全局命令，比如“紧急维修”和“固定好准备机动”（你懂的，让他们在被压死之前坐进防撞座椅。）
-缺乏高级搬运/交易区域控制，无法让你精确指定物品应该存放在哪里，也无法让NPC真正把物品搬运到那里存放。目前，如果我购买废料，它最终会出现在我的冰箱里，即使冰箱被设置为“仅限食物”区域。反过来也会发生。
-物理模拟有点太简单了。你把推进器放在哪里、你的质心在哪里都无所谓，飞船的表现都一样。空气动力学完全由质量和你有多少重型升力旋翼以及空气动力学船体部件决定，而不一定是飞船的形状。没有爆炸性失压，使用重型升力旋翼的大气飞行也需要重新调整。（具体来说，你必须拥有偶数个顺时针和逆时针旋转的重型升力旋翼，否则你就会陷入死亡旋转。除了断电再重新通电之外，没有办法改变方向。）
-物品栏就是很奇怪。你有一套太空服，但没有专门设计的包可以在穿着太空服时携带东西，所以你的角色必须占用一只手，永久拖着一个背包。
只能永久拖着一个背包，占用一只手。
-无法自动穿上/脱下宇航服。在一个人在宇航服中待够足够长的时间之前（据我所知要一个月以上），他们会遭受严重的工作速度惩罚。
-缺乏真正的气闸。每当船员进出飞船时，你总是会短暂地泄漏大气，因为气闸实际上只是相隔几英尺的两扇门，无法对气闸进行“循环”。
-缺乏船员留存和福利。船员每天的报酬少得可怜。你可能在一次贸易运输中赚到数百万，但他们只拿到250美元。对他们微观管理得太狠，或者没有满足他们的某项需求（这些需求有些模糊不清），他们就会直接辞职不干，而且在他们决定辞职之前，你没有办法给他们更高的薪水。一种奖励辛勤工作（因为船员确实会偷懒）/让他们的薪酬与他们加入后发展出的技能相匹配的方式，甚至也许一个医疗计划来自动治疗当你的飞船突然失压、他们的皮肤沸腾时他们得到的那些讨厌的水泡，将会是非常棒的补充。

这些只是列举几个，幸运的是，有一些模组可以覆盖一些半成品功能，在我看来应该被纳入完整游戏中：

“Ship's Water”——一个添加水箱、淋浴、废水储存/处理以及批量购买水的能力的模组。否则，你只能在空间站上缓慢补水的洗手池里灌瓶子，或者繁琐地购买一箱箱的水。无论有没有这个模组，船员都需要用水喝水和洗澡，但这让管理水变得不那么繁琐。这绝对是一个“必备”模组。

“Uninstall and Haul”——在原版中，当你第一次与一艘残骸对接时，你可以跑过去并用“卸载”命令标记任何你想完好打捞的东西。不幸的是，在组件被卸载后，你还得再命令把它“搬运”回你的飞船。这个模组添加了一个组合命令，将为你节省大量时间和不必要的繁琐操作。

Great foundation, but 1.0 still feels unpolished at its core.
I love the core concept of the game, but the 1.0 release still suffers from severe QoL, performance, and UI issues that ruin the experience:

    Stuttering / Performance: Once I operate a mid-sized ship, running the game at 4x speed or higher causes constant stuttering. It gets significantly worse when assigning multiple tasks to the crew.

    Lack of Information: When work stops, the game gives zero feedback on why (missing parts, dead battery, or personal needs/morale issue). Having to manually check every single variable is extremely tedious.

    Clunky Autotasks & AI:
        During auto-repairs, crew members carry loose parts one by one instead of using their backpacks. Is this intentional?
        I can't assign crew to specialized roles (e.g., dedicated EVA worker vs. interior repairperson).
        Zones are also restrictive and frustrating because they cannot overlap.

    Bugs: Critical features randomly break. For example, my airlock doors suddenly stopped responding to electrical signals for no reason. It works when I restart with previous savefile. I have to role-back several times. And why I see the bug information when I reload savefile?

    Frustrating UI & Fixed Keybindings: Awkward quick-button assignments (like fixed hotkeys causing you to accidentally bash floors) combined with frame stuttering lead to constant, maddening misclicks.

Verdict:
The game itself is good and I really want to enjoy it, but these friction points make playing it exhausting right now. I’ll come back after a few more patches.

-----------------

After another full 3 more days:
I accept the concepts. AI is dull, so I do smart. Now I'm carrying crate-of-parts for repairing. Also prepare Autotask step-by-step. Now my hand can expect quick action and press it without misclicks. Most of information are etched. Still improvement is needed, but now I change my mind. Most of them are by design. At least, I accept. Anyway, scavenging is fun.

items.text:
[h2]A great core idea but with an underbaked release[/h2]

I've had my eye on this game for a long time, deliberately holding off until it was finished. So I was thrilled to see it hit 1.0 a few days ago, and with a sale on top of that I bought it immediately. The recent mixed reviews gave me pause, but I didn't pay them much attention because I wanted to finally experience the game for myself. In hindsight I probably should have listened, because I now find myself agreeing with the consensus: this is a very underbaked 1.0.

And I don't just mean bugs, of which there are many. You can tell while playing that a lot of features were built to about 20% and then left there.

Space navigation. It's genuinely very well done and enjoyable, and it's the one part of this game I have nothing bad to say about.

One example that stands in for a dozen: I have a zone full of building materials, a cart in my hands, and a blueprint waiting to be filled, and my character will deliver the materials [b]one at a time[/b], despite correctly using the cart when I explicitly tell him to haul. These systems are just plainly unfinished.

My read is that the devs got overly ambitious and tried to implement a lot of different things at once instead of going vertical and polishing each set of features before moving on, until they hit some kind of wall (money ran out, publisher pressure, burnout after years on the same project, who knows) and ultimately labeled this a finished product.

The NPC system exemplifies this. Hiring crew, but also just talking to station NPCs to handle mood requirements: something I thought was really cool for the first two minutes and that turned out so bad I wish it simply wasn't in the game. Contrast this with something like Project Zomboid, where the devs pulled NPCs entirely because they weren't satisfied with the implementation, and shipped narrow but fully polished slices with each release instead. That's the discipline this game needed, rather than forcing a broken system in.

[h3]Where that leaves me[/h3]
Exactly where I was trying not to be by waiting for 1.0: enamored with the premise and creative direction, but frustrated enough with the state of the game that I can't enjoy it without getting mad at some system not working properly every five minutes.

The devs have promised at least another year of development, and I hope that means more than a few bugfixes, because several systems urgently need more love and attention. As things stand I can't recommend it to new players, partly so nobody else walks into what I walked into. Wait 6 to 12 months and see where the progress is by then, because whatever labels are used, [b]this game is still in an EA state[/b].

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Software engineering side note[/h3]
I've read the dev's post about not wanting to use generative AI for coding tasks, and everyone is free to work how they please, but as a software engineer I think it's a self-inflicted wound. Getting half-finished features across the line is exactly where these tools are strongest. Hardcoded text strings apparently blocking localization is a couple of days of work at most with an assistant scanning the codebase for them.

[h2]一个很棒的核心创意，但发布版本火候未到[/h2]

我关注这款游戏已经很久了，一直刻意等到它完成才入手。所以几天前看到它发布1.0版本时我非常激动，再加上还有打折，我立刻就买了下来。最近的褒贬不一评价让我犹豫了一下，但我没太在意，因为我想终于亲自体验一下这款游戏。事后看来，我大概应该听进去的，因为我现在发现自己同意主流看法：这是一个非常半生不熟的1.0版本。

而且我说的不只是bug，虽然bug确实很多。玩的时候你就能看出来，很多功能只做到了大约20%就被搁置了。

太空导航。这部分确实做得非常好，也很有趣，是这款游戏里我唯一挑不出毛病的地方。

举一个能代表十几个问题的例子：我有一个堆满建筑材料的区域，手里有一辆推车，还有一个等着被填充的蓝图，而我的角色会[b]一次一件地[/b]运送材料，尽管当我明确告诉他要搬运时，他确实会正确使用推车。这些系统显然就是没做完。

我的理解是，开发者过于雄心勃勃，试图一次性实现很多不同的东西，而不是纵向深入、在继续前进之前把每一组功能打磨好，直到他们撞上了某种墙（钱花完了、发行商施压、在同一个项目上做了多年后倦怠了，谁知道呢），最终把这个标成了完成品。

NPC系统就是典型例子。雇佣船员，以及仅仅为了处理心情需求而和空间站NPC交谈：这东西我头两分钟还觉得真的很酷，结果差到我希望它干脆别出现在游戏里。对比一下《僵尸毁灭工程》这样的作品，那边的开发者因为对NPC实现不满意而把NPC整个撤掉了，每次发布都只推出范围狭窄但完全打磨好的部分。这才是这款游戏需要的自律，而不是硬塞进一个坏掉的系统。

[h3]这让我处于什么境地[/h3]
正是我当初等到1.0就是想避免的境地：被它的前提和创作方向迷住了，但对游戏的状态沮丧到无法享受它，因为每五分钟就会因为某个系统不能正常工作而生气。

开发者承诺至少还会再开发一年，我希望这不只是修几个bug，因为有好几个系统迫切需要更多关爱和关注。就目前情况而言，我无法向新玩家推荐它，部分原因也是不想让别人再走进我走进的这个坑。等6到12个月，看看那时进展如何，因为不管用什么标签，[b]这款游戏仍然处于EA状态[/b]。

[hr][/hr]

[h3]软件工程方面的附注[/h3]
我读过开发者关于不想在编码任务中使用生成式AI的帖子，每个人都有按自己意愿工作的自由，但作为一名软件工程师，我认为这是自找麻烦。把半成品功能推过终点线，恰恰是这些工具最擅长的地方。据说阻碍本地化的硬编码文本字符串，在助手的帮助下扫描代码库找出它们，最多也就几天的工作量。

At present, in its current form, all of the game's flaws worth noting are a result of frankly terrible design choices that should not have seen the light of day. Inventory management is a complete nightmare first and foremost, with the very concept of organization being a mortal enemy of the devs. Imagine if you had a book case. But Despite being as all as you, that case only has three shelves. And only one book can be put on each shelf. This is literally how the inventory system in the game works. Which is funny, because a 1 meter tall shelf has LESS of these "slots" than a pair of overalls. That's right, your jumpsuits has four slots. MORE FREE SPACE than a literal industrial storage rack. The overhead bin on an airplane that you can fit and entire suitcase and some extra luggage inside of? Six slots. Wear a pair of cargo pants, you'll get like ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ TWELVE instead. 

ALL logic in the game follows this ridiculous philosophy. The "trade off" for wearing normal clothes with pockets like a sane person instead of only moving one single toothpick at a time? You can't wear a space suit. At all. Not even "put it on over the clothes." No, you can't just buy a bigger pair of pants to wear over the space suit, and god forbid you just add pouches or a fanny pack to the suit you filthy heretic. Your suit can only have two slots. The bare minimum you'll need for your tools is three. 

Do you want a coffee machine? Too bad. You're barely tolerated being allowed to interact with them, let alone just buying one. Why? Because they just decided you don't deserve that privilege.

Do you want to salvage ships like the game advertises? ♥♥♥♥ you. You have to deal with random supernatural magical ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ because the devs wanted to shoehorn in their own homebrew SCPs. There's supposedly an entire system for investigating and solving the death and potential murders of unlucky bastards who die on ships you're salvaging. I wouldn't know, because I've been completely locked out of it by literally every single corpse invoking this supernatural dickery. You didn't ask? Too bad, now ships will randomly have giant tumors on them that may or may not try to kill you like cancerous amoebas.

The AI lacks any more sophisticated logic than taking the shortest route from point A to B. Regardless of any objects that they might fatally collide into when going as fast as possible at all times and costs. It's so bad that the docking system is forced to teleport objects and ships into position when they get close enough. This more often than not has unintended side effects, just as teleporting a third party ship in-between you and another ship you're trying to dock with. Or ALREADY docked with. Have fun with the ensuing G-mod style cacophony .

And on and on and on it goes. The best way to describe the game is as the middle ground between Rimworld and Barotrauma, but with none of the clever techniques that really make those games work. It's a good game, and you'll enjoy yourself if you're extremely patient. You just have to be able to tolerate the fact that the game does not respect you or your time in spite of the money you've given up for it.

目前，以其当前的形式来看，这款游戏所有值得一提的缺陷都是那些本不该见天日的、坦率地说糟糕透顶的设计选择所导致的。物品栏管理首先就是一场彻头彻尾的噩梦，组织整理这个概念本身就是开发者的死敌。想象一下你有一个书柜。但尽管它和你一样高，这个柜子却只有三层搁板。而且每层只能放一本书。这字面意义上就是游戏中物品栏系统的运作方式。这很滑稽，因为一个1米高的搁板拥有的这些“槽位”比一条背带裤还少。没错，你的连体工作服有四个槽位。比一个真正的工业储物架拥有更多的可用空间。飞机上那个能塞进一整个行李箱外加一些额外行李的头顶行李舱？六个槽位。穿一条工装裤，你会得到大概他妈的十二个。

游戏中的所有逻辑都遵循这套荒谬的哲学。穿带有口袋的正常衣服、像个正常人一样行事，而不是一次只搬运一根牙签的“代价”是什么？你不能穿太空服。完全不能。甚至不能“套在衣服外面穿”。不，你不能直接买一条更大的裤子套在太空服外面，而且天 forbid 你往太空服上加几个小包或一个腰包，你这个肮脏的异端。你的太空服只能有两个槽位。而你工具所需的最低限度是三个。

你想要一台咖啡机？太糟了。你能被允许去操作它们就已经算是勉强容忍了，更别提买一台了。为什么？因为他们就是决定你不配拥有那种特权。

你想像游戏宣传的那样打捞飞船？去你妈的。你必须应对随机的超自然魔法狗屎，因为开发者想把他们自己自制的SCP硬塞进来。据说有一整套系统用于调查和解决那些在你打捞的飞船上不幸死去的倒霉蛋的死亡和潜在谋杀案。我不清楚，因为我被每一具尸体引发的这种超自然胡搞彻底锁在了门外。你没要求？太糟了，现在飞船会随机长出巨大的肿瘤，它们可能会也可能不会像癌变的阿米巴原虫一样试图杀死你。

AI缺乏任何比从A点到B点走最短路线更复杂的逻辑。不管它们在始终以最快速度、不惜一切代价前进时可能致命撞上的任何物体。糟糕到对接系统被迫在物体和飞船足够接近时将它们传送就位。这往往会产生意想不到的副作用，比如把一艘第三方飞船传送到你和你正试图对接的另一艘飞船之间。或者已经对接上的。好好享受随之而来的G-mod风格的大杂烩吧。

如此这般，没完没了。描述这款游戏的最佳方式是《环世界》和《潜渊症》之间的中间地带，但完全没有那些真正让那两款游戏运作起来的巧妙技巧。这是一款好游戏，如果你极其有耐心，你会玩得开心。你只需要能够容忍这样一个事实：尽管你为它付出了金钱，这款游戏并不尊重你或你的时间。
