items.text:
If you're looking at this page, Ostranauts absolutely delivers on the experience you're looking for. The worldbuilding really puts you into the setting, and the core gameplay mechanics have you feeling like a proper spacer. Unfortunately, this is all marred by the absolutely atrocious state the game is in.

At its core, this is a game about inventory management. Both the size and shape of your ship is going to determine what types and what amounts of salvage you can bring aboard. External cargo netting is cheap, light, and quick to lay down, but accessing its inventory means donning a suit for a spacewalk. Underfloor storage bays are expensive, but they allow you to fit a large amount of salvage in a smaller, more convenient space that can even be pressurized. Unfortunately, they're also heavier, which means they have a more sizeable impact on your fuel and thrusters.

For all this, the actual tools the game has for inventory management are absolute garbage. It's 2026, and the game doesn't even have a "Deposit/Stack similar items" button for containers. Shift-clicking prefers to deposit items on the ground instead of the active container, which means you'll have to manually drag items into their proper containers, one by one. This is a game with 10 different types of scrap; all of which are needed for repairing various salvage. There is a host of various supplies you need to keep track of on your ship, and the game does nothing to help make it easier.

And then there's the bugs. So much of the UI seems to be either placeholder or so broken it doesn't even work. The "resume order" button which appears on every pending order has simply never worked for me; to force a character to manually do an assigned work order, you'll have to cancel the order, then start it up again from their specific menu. There is an entire menu for a task priority system, but it's all placeholder, as it doesn't actually do anything.

A good hazard should be either preventable or react-able. Having it be neither is what leads to frustrating gameplay. Fires are seemingly not preventable. A breathing environment that is 100% oxygen is highly combustible, so adding nitrogen to the mix will help reduce the chances of fires starting. Damaged electronics have a chance of malfunctioning and starting a fire, so keeping everything maintained is important. Unfortunately, doing any welding work has a chance of setting surrounding items on fire, regardless of environment or condition. Doing welding work on a wall can set fire to the perfectly maintained power line embedded in it. Doing welding work on a reactor core with nothing flammable in the room has a chance of your character setting their own pants on fire.

Fires are also not truly react-able. If you immediately respond to a fire by having everyone don their pressure/eva suits (which they keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), then begin using their fire extinguishers (which they also keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), while having someone immediately vent the ship to starve the fire & and pull out the smoke... everyone who was in the room now has chronic emphysema from smoke inhalation. The fact that fires are a hazard that are neither fully preventable nor react-able without permanent consequence is the reason why you can see every other recent negative review complaining about fires. This is on top of the fact that, like everything else in the game, fires give no feedback at all on what actually caused the fire, so new players will have an especially rough time figuring out what's going on.

Building ships is the epitome of the poor UI design in this game. The game has one menu for installing tiles & components, and a separate menu for every other order in the game. You can not pull both of these menus up at the same time. This means that if you need to undo a build order, you'll need to back out of the build menu and go into the orders menu to cancel it. 

There is also no option for selecting a palette or filtering out any of the build options. The game only has the bare minimum of separate categories (HVAC, Powergen, Hull Tiles, etc). This means that when you go back to the build menu, you've lost your place and have to find the tiles you were working with. These all seem like small nitpicks, but they're things that add up and build frustration with time. 

Speaking of small nitpicks, there is so much pointless micromanagement, and the game is prone to the kind of mistakes you only make because you're playing a video game. For some odd reason, left & right shoes are treated as separate entities instead of being bundled together. This adds nothing to the game. It's just 4 extra pointless clicks that can be another pain point if you, going through the motions, somehow manage to put the shoe on the wrong foot. If so, your character can develop painful blisters that slow down work/movement speed. Your character won't complain, so this can persist until you tab to them, wonder why they're in pain, then realize they have their shoes on the wrong feet. It feels like the video game equivalent of a pointless DM gotcha. This doesn't happen in real life. People don't usually just put their shoes on the wrong foot by accident and then deal with it until they get blisters on their feet.

Clothing management is an interesting system, but it's such a slog to actually go through. Casual clothes are comfortable and reduce filth gain. This is important, since crewmembers on break need to be comfortable to read skill books and generate increased filth if they're working out. Unfortunately, there's no uniform system, so, even on scheduled break time, characters won't switch back to their casual clothes by themselves. This leads to more pointless micro you have to do for every character you control.

God forbid a crewmember decide it's a good time to go for a 6-hour marathon after you forget to doff their eva suit (which increases filth gain). Characters are coded to automatically use hygiene packs when they get dirty, but if you run out (which you will, because the station doesn't stock enough), there is no option to allow them to automatically use the copious amounts of water you have for washing. There is no cap on filth, and no ability to queue tasks, so you can waste minutes just watching and retasking a character to wash themselves off with water instead of hygiene packs. The AI in general is a crapshoot, and constantly wastes your time with its problems.

The kicker is that a lot of these problems have persisted even after a "hardening phase" in which the developers focused on QoL and bugfixing.

This game desperately needs a QoL pass by someone with some proper UI/UX experience. There are also a lot of broken elements that simply aren't the sort of things you leave until the end to fix. Underneath all the dirt, there is an absolute gem of a game here. However, unless you're patient, have a lot of free time on your hands, and absolutely in love with the genre, I highly recommend waiting for the game to be in a more polished state.

I eagerly await the day I can change this review, but, until then, I've already been lead astray by other Early Access titles that have focused on constant content updates while leaving maintenance work by the wayside. More often than not, tech debt accumulates to the point where the developers decide to just release as-is; sometimes even starting work on a sequel with a "stronger base". I pray that Ostranauts can buck the trend, because there's a really good game underneath all the mess.
items.text_zh:
如果你正在看这个页面，那么 Ostranauts 绝对能提供你正在寻找的那种体验。世界观构建真正让你沉浸到设定之中，核心玩法机制让你感觉自己就是个正经的太空人。不幸的是，这一切都被游戏目前极其糟糕的状态给毁了。

从本质上讲，这是一款关于库存管理的游戏。你飞船的大小和形状将决定你能带上船的打捞物类型和数量。外部货网便宜、轻便、铺设迅速，但要访问它的库存就意味着得穿上宇航服进行太空行走。地板下的储物舱很昂贵，但它们能让你在更小、更方便甚至还能加压的空间里装下大量打捞物。不幸的是，它们也更重，这意味着它们对你的燃料和推进器有更显著的影响。

尽管如此，游戏实际用于库存管理的工具简直是垃圾。都2026年了，游戏甚至没有一个针对容器的“存入/堆叠同类物品”按钮。Shift点击更倾向于把物品放到地上而不是当前激活的容器里，这意味着你不得不手动把物品一个一个拖进它们该去的容器。这是一款有10种不同废料的游戏；而修复各种打捞物都需要用到它们。你船上有一大堆各种补给需要跟踪管理，而游戏完全不帮忙让它变得更容易。

然后就是bug。UI的很大一部分似乎要么是占位符，要么坏得根本不能用。每个待处理订单上出现的“恢复订单”按钮对我来说从来就没起过作用；要强迫一个角色手动执行分配的工作订单，你得先取消订单，然后从他们的专属菜单里重新启动它。有一个完整的任务优先级系统菜单，但全是占位符，因为它实际上什么都不做。

一个好的危险应该要么可预防，要么可应对。两者皆非正是导致令人沮丧的游戏体验的原因。火灾似乎无法预防。100%氧气的呼吸环境高度易燃，所以在混合气体中加入氮气有助于降低起火几率。受损的电子设备有几率发生故障并引发火灾，所以保持一切维护良好很重要。不幸的是，进行任何焊接工作都有几率点燃周围的物品，无论环境或状况如何。在一面墙上进行焊接工作可能会点燃嵌入其中维护得完美无缺的电线。在一个没有任何易燃物的房间里对反应堆核心进行焊接工作，有几率让你的角色把自己的裤子点着。

火灾也不是真正可应对的。如果你对火灾的立即反应是让所有人穿上他们的压力服/EVA服（他们为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），然后开始使用他们的灭火器（他们同样为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），同时让某人立即给飞船泄压以饿死火焰并排出烟雾……原本在那个房间里的每个人现在都因为吸入烟雾而患上了慢性肺气肿。火灾是一种既不能完全预防、也不能在无永久性后果的情况下应对的危险，这就是为什么你能看到其他每一条最近的负面评测都在抱怨火灾。除此之外，就像游戏里的其他一切一样，火灾完全不提供任何关于究竟是什么引发了火灾的反馈，所以新玩家会尤其艰难地搞不清楚到底发生了什么。

建造飞船是这款游戏糟糕UI设计的典型代表。游戏有一个用于安装地板砖和组件的菜单，而游戏里其他所有订单则有一个单独的菜单。你无法同时调出这两个菜单。这意味着如果你需要撤销一个建造订单，你得退出建造菜单，再进入订单菜单去取消它。

也没有选择调色板或过滤任何建造选项的功能。游戏只有最低限度的几个独立分类（暖通空调、发电、船体地板砖等）。这意味着当你回到建造菜单时，你已经丢失了原来的位置，不得不重新找到你之前正在处理的地板砖。这些看起来都像是小的吹毛求疵，但它们是会随着时间累积并滋生挫败感的东西。

说到小的吹毛求疵，游戏里有太多毫无意义的微观管理，而且游戏很容易犯那种你只因为是在玩电子游戏才会犯的错误。出于某种奇怪的原因，左脚鞋和右脚鞋被当作独立的实体，而不是捆绑在一起。这对游戏毫无增益。这只是多出4次毫无意义的点击，而且如果你在机械地操作时不知怎么把鞋穿错了脚，这还可能成为另一个痛点。如果穿错了，你的角色会起疼痛的水泡，从而减慢工作/移动速度。你的角色不会抱怨，所以这种情况可能会一直持续，直到你切到他们身上，纳闷他们为什么在疼痛，然后才意识到他们把鞋穿错了脚。这感觉就像是电子游戏版的毫无意义的DM陷阱。这在现实生活中不会发生。人们通常不会不小心把鞋穿错脚，然后一直忍着直到脚上起水泡。

服装管理是一个有趣的系统，但实际走一遍流程实在太累人了。休闲服舒适并能减少污垢积累。这很重要，因为休息中的船员需要舒适才能阅读技能书，而如果他们正在锻炼则会积累更多污垢。不幸的是，没有制服系统，所以即使是在预定的休息时间，角色也不会自己换回休闲服。这导致你不得不为你控制的每个角色做更多毫无意义的微观操作。

天哪，要是你忘了让某个船员脱下他们的EVA服（这会增加污垢积累），而他们决定这时候去跑个6小时马拉松，那可就糟了。角色的编码设定是当他们变脏时会自动使用卫生包，但如果你用完了（你一定会用完的，因为空间站储备不够），就没有选项允许他们自动使用你手头大量用于清洗的水。污垢没有上限，也没有排队任务的能力，所以你可能会浪费好几分钟就只是看着一个角色并重新指派他们用水而不是卫生包来清洗自己。AI总体来说就是一场赌博，不断用它的各种问题浪费你的时间。

最要命的是，很多这些问题即使在开发者专注于QoL和修bug的“加固阶段”之后依然存在。

这款游戏迫切需要由某个有正经UI/UX经验的人来做一次QoL优化。还有很多损坏的元素，根本不是那种你可以留到最后再修的东西。在所有这些污垢之下，这里有一款绝对堪称瑰宝的游戏。然而，除非你有耐心、手头有大把空闲时间、并且绝对热爱这个类型，否则我强烈建议等游戏进入更完善的状态再说。

我热切期待有一天我能修改这篇评测，但在那之前，我已经被其他那些专注于不断更新内容却把维护工作抛在一边的抢先体验游戏带偏过了。很多时候，技术债会累积到开发者决定就这么原样发布的地步；有时甚至带着“更坚实的基础”开始做续作。我祈祷 Ostranauts 能逆势而行，因为在这一团乱麻之下，真的有一款非常好的游戏。
完全没有关于火灾实际起因的反馈，所以新玩家会特别难以弄清楚到底发生了什么。

建造飞船是这款游戏糟糕UI设计的典型代表。游戏有一个用于安装地板砖和组件的菜单，而游戏中其他所有指令都有一个单独的菜单。你无法同时调出这两个菜单。这意味着如果你需要撤销一个建造指令，你必须退出建造菜单，然后进入指令菜单来取消它。

也没有选择调色板或过滤任何建造选项的功能。游戏只有最基础的几个独立分类（暖通空调、发电、船体地板砖等）。这意味着当你回到建造菜单时，你已经丢失了原来的位置，必须重新找到你正在使用的地板砖。这些看起来都是小毛病，但它们会累积起来，随着时间推移不断积累挫败感。

说到小毛病，有太多毫无意义的微观管理，而且游戏很容易出现那种只因你在玩电子游戏才会犯的错误。出于某种奇怪的原因，左脚鞋和右脚鞋被当作独立实体，而不是捆绑在一起。这对游戏毫无增益。这只是多出4次毫无意义的点击，而且如果你在机械操作中不知怎么把鞋穿到了错误的脚上，这还可能成为另一个痛点。如果这样，你的角色会起疼痛的水泡，减慢工作/移动速度。你的角色不会抱怨，所以这种情况会一直持续，直到你切换到他们，纳闷他们为什么在疼痛，然后才意识到他们把鞋穿错了脚。感觉就像电子游戏版的毫无意义的DM陷阱。这在现实生活中不会发生。人们通常不会不小心把鞋穿错脚，然后一直忍着直到脚上起水泡。

服装管理是一个有趣的系统，但实际去操作它实在太费劲了。休闲服舒适并减少污垢积累。这很重要，因为休息中的船员需要舒适才能阅读技能书，而如果他们锻炼则会增加污垢积累。不幸的是，没有制服系统，所以即使在预定的休息时间，角色也不会自己换回休闲服。这导致你不得不为你控制的每个角色做更多毫无意义的微观管理。

天哪，千万别让一个船员在你忘记让他们脱下EVA服（这会增加污垢积累）之后决定去跑一场6小时的马拉松。角色被设定为变脏时自动使用卫生包，但如果你用完了（你一定会用完，因为空间站储备不够），就没有选项让他们自动使用你拥有的大量水来清洗。污垢没有上限，也没有排队任务的能力，所以你可能会浪费几分钟只是看着并重新指派一个角色用水而不是卫生包来清洗自己。AI总体来说就是碰运气，并且不断用它的各种问题浪费你的时间。

最要命的是，很多这些问题即使在开发者专注于QoL和修bug的“加固阶段”之后依然存在。

这款游戏迫切需要一位有真正UI/UX经验的人来做一次QoL优化。还有很多损坏的元素，这些根本不是那种可以留到最后才修的东西。在所有这些污垢之下，这里绝对是一款宝石级的游戏。然而，除非你有耐心、有大量空闲时间，并且绝对热爱这个类型，我强烈建议等游戏进入更完善的状态再玩。
如果你手头有大把时间，而且绝对热爱这个类型，我强烈建议等到游戏处于更完善的状态再入手。

我热切期盼着有一天我能修改这篇评测，但在此之前，我已经被其他抢先体验作品带偏过——它们专注于不断更新内容，却把维护工作抛在一边。多数情况下，技术债会累积到开发者干脆决定就这么原样发布；有时甚至开始用“更坚实的基础”去做续作。我祈祷Ostranauts能打破这个趋势，因为在这一团乱麻之下，真的有一款非常好的游戏。

items.text:
Media embodiment of autism. Clocked close to 50 hours within the first few days of playing this. Yet I've decided to put it down until it becomes more polished.

There is just this feeling with this game that the developers are so driven to create a complex system that they aren't focused to slow down and refine the individual core processes that are the pieces that bring that system alive.

They're soon to add ship-combat but how long can they keep putting systems together before it eventually just becomes too much? I would really suggest the developers to slow down a little and simply work out how to make the game more playable (the keyword being playable, not fun, nor complex - both it is - but playable).

A few core systems are lacking depth that pull you out of the game given how immersive it can be at times:
- mental status/social/relationships seem to have no real significant impact on gameplay; I rolled a smoker character. To light a cigarette you have to a) have cigarettes in the pack itself) b) action the pack of cigarettes to light a cigarette) c) put out the cigarette but dragging it from your mouth to the trash or on the floor - turns out if you're suffering a nicotine withdrawl it does little to actually affect your gameplay meaning you can simply select smoker for a free point and never smoke. 
- The UI is incredibly clunky and difficult to navigate; Why can't I pin my inventory to always be displayed? The game becomes a slog after you start to manage your needs alongside your crew and ship. Why can't I customise the UI features? I don't half my screen obscured by an event log when half the event log is fluff in itself. 
- variety of items (excluding ship items)

I don't know if this is a bug or not but I left items outside of the ship during a derelict run and when I docked at the station all the items were still where I left them but had somehow traveled half way across the star system without being in a cargoweb? I spent 15 minutes putting together a cargo web system on the backend to ensure I can carry more items to find out I can just game it by not doing so (which I refuse to do so but it just pulls you out when you know you can. It also turns out you can just use floor tiles to do so as well... Why bother with a cargo web item if you can just a) game the system, b) rip a floor off a ship your salvaging and always have storage - this gets to a point where you start to not worry about what you can take and can't take as you know you can just rip stuff apart and throw it on the back of your ship without any care or worry...

Further example... Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back. The feature of the proximity alarm is crucial to space travel - why can't there be a little toggle next to it in-it-self to toggle on and off upon docking? You can link your NAV console to your PDA - why can't I simply toggle it from my PDA? Or simply add a new PDA chip that allows you to do so? These little touches that would make it less of a chore.

I think this will hands down be the best simulator on the market once the time comes - but it's a matter of when, not if. 

I still highly recommend it - the above is simply feedback for the developers.

自闭症在媒体中的化身。在开始玩这款游戏的几天内，游戏时间就接近50小时。然而我决定先放下它，直到它变得更加完善。

这款游戏给人一种感觉：开发者如此执着于创建一个复杂的系统，以至于他们没有专注于放慢脚步，去打磨那些让整个系统活起来的各个核心流程。

他们很快就要加入飞船战斗，但在最终变得太多之前，他们还能把系统拼凑多久？我真的建议开发者放慢一点，简单地想办法让游戏更可玩（关键词是可玩，不是有趣，也不是复杂——这两者它都具备——而是可玩）。

有几个核心系统缺乏深度，考虑到游戏有时能如此沉浸，这会把你从游戏中拉出来：
- 精神状态/社交/关系似乎对玩法没有真正显著的影响；我随机了一个吸烟者角色。要点燃一支烟，你必须 a) 烟盒里本身有烟 b) 对烟盒执行动作来点燃一支烟 c) 熄灭香烟，但要把烟从嘴里拖到垃圾桶或地板上——结果发现，如果你正遭受尼古丁戒断，它实际上对玩法几乎没有影响，这意味着你可以直接选择吸烟者来白拿一个点数，然后永远不抽烟。
- UI极其笨重且难以操作；为什么我不能把物品栏固定为始终显示？当你开始同时管理自己的需求、船员和飞船时，游戏就变成了一件苦差事。为什么我不能自定义UI功能？我可不想半个屏幕被事件日志挡住，而事件日志本身有一半都是废话。
- 物品种类（不包括飞船物品）

我不知道这是不是bug，但我在一次废弃飞船探索中把物品留在了飞船外面，当我在空间站停靠时，所有物品都还在我留下的地方，却不知怎么在不在货网里的情况下穿越了半个星系？我花了15分钟在后端搭建了一个货网系统，以确保我能携带更多物品，结果发现我只要不这么做就能钻空子（我拒绝这么做，但当你知道自己可以这么做时，它就会把你从游戏中拉出来。结果还发现你只要用地板砖也能做到……如果你能 a) 钻系统空子，b) 从你正在打捞的飞船上拆下一块地板，然后永远都有存储空间，那还要货网物品干什么——这到了某个地步，你开始不再担心自己能拿什么、不能拿什么，因为你知道你可以随便把东西拆开，毫不在意、毫不担心地扔到飞船后面……

再举个例子……我把飞船停靠好了，但忘了关掉我的接近警报。现在得关掉我的菜单，一路走回我的飞船，右键点击导航中心——把它们放进去。点击警报。让它们从座位上起来。再一路走回去。接近警报这个功能对太空旅行至关重要——为什么不能在它旁边本身就有个小开关，在停靠时切换开和关？你可以把你的导航控制台连接到你的PDA——为什么我不能直接从我的PDA上切换它？或者干脆加一个新的PDA芯片让你能做到这一点？这些小小的细节会让它少很多麻烦。

我认为等到时机成熟，这毫无疑问会是市场上最好的模拟器——但问题是什么时候，而不是会不会。

我仍然强烈推荐它——以上只是给开发者的反馈。

So at the time of this writing I have 1527 hours into this game. This game is a cassette futurism themed look and feel (Think like 1979 Alien, knobs and buttons). It is set in space after a disaster renders Earths orbit impossible to safely travel, leaving the rest of the solar system cut off.

Hyper capitalism controls everything, everything is trying to bleed you for every red cent. Your lucky enough to start with a junker of a ship.... That has a crushing mortgage that must be paid in installments every 6 hours.

This game doesn't hold your hand, you have to figure everything out more or less on your own. There is a manual that explains basic ship functions, and reactor set ups, etc etc. READ IT. It's the only help you get.

There is a tutorial that will lead you to your first derelict ship to salvage various equipment from, and possibly a salvage license... Oh did I forget to mention? The local station owns even the dead ships, you can salvage anything you want, but to do it legally, you need a license... They however don't care how you "aquire" this license.... Its not like a name is on them or anything.... Otherwise you can just buy them... If you can afford them.

Anyway, the basic game loop is all about salvaging stuff, fixing the salvage up, and then selling it to the license vendor, scrap vendor, or if your smooth, a black market dealer who sometimes pays top dollar for certain items/data files.

Your goal is to pay off your ship, after that, the solar system is more or less your oyster. You can salvage equipment and sell it, or even salvage entire ships with the purpose of using their bones to build out your ship. Or you can even buy derelict ships and fix them up and resell them, or use them yourself, or you can even buy functioning used ships at a hyper inflated price. Everything, big and small is modifiable if you can find the parts you want/need, your imagination is the limit.

Eventually, you have a reactor and you can start traveling to other planets using a drive thats associated with it. Buy and sell cargo to make really big money, Buy your citizenship (yes, even if you're born somewhere, you're still illegal). Citizenship visa's come with discounts at their cargo traders, which means more money for cargo hauling.

The only down sides to this game is some things aren't very well explained and you either have to ask someone or do the trial and error method, which can be a bit off putting.

The NPC AI is pretty bad too, though it is improving and has come a long way from what it was not long ago. That said I don't recommend hiring NPC crew, as you have to micro manage -almost- everything they do. This is however early access and before the AI can be truly worked on and fixed, all the games features need to be added. So it will improve closer to release.

But once you get the hang of the game, you will have experiences like the below example which was my experience tonight to end my current play through:

-----------------------------------------

Tonight started off with a mad attempt to dock with one of the stations down in the Venus atmosphere, Long Beach Terminal to be exact.

Many lessons were learned in the process of docking with the aerostat. First of all, I burned way too much RCS trying to get down to the atmosphere to begin with, actually running out of N2 on the way down. 

Due to the strong gravitational pull of the planet, you have to burn high-G reverse thrust to mantain a consistant speed, otherwise the you will increase in velocity by hundreds of m/s in a very short period of time. That being said, I was out of RCS and falling towards the planet. 

Turning on my rotors (two of which were broken on the way down by micro meteors) and just crossed my fingers. Eventually when the atmospheric pressure hit 15Kpa the rotors started to function for more than just rotation and i was able to slow down and maintain a docking altitude with the station, managing to dock by the skin of my teeth.

While docked at the station, I purchased some media cargo to bring back to OKLG later.

When I was ready to leave, I undocked and learned a couple of things, the Pirates don't always have ships powerful enough to break free of Venus' gravity, as I watched one that was tracking me fall away down towards the planet and eventually getting destroyed. I also learned that while 4 rotors were enough to keep my ship from falling towards the planet, they wern't powerful enough to lift the ship up to the edge of the atmosphere.

Attempt number one to leave Venus I managed to use the RCS to get out of the "no wake zone" but realized fairly quickly that I didn't have enough RCS to make it up to VORB, thus began attempt at manual Torch flight number one.

I got the Torch drive engaged and figured out how maneuvering with it worked and started to head for VORB, but unfortunately I somehow overheated the reactor and damaged the ablative liner causing a loud alarm to start sounding, pretty much ending the first attempt, as I didn't have any extra liners. Lesson learned.

Reloaded the save and used SFF (Time Skip up to 6 hours) for an extra hour so that VORB was closer to the planet. Bought extra ablative liners for the reactor just in case, then undocked and made attempt number 2 to get back to VORB.

This time, I switched to RCS as soon as I undocked and headed full burn for the edge of the wake zone.

This time, with VORB being much closer, it actually orbited over head and past us and I had to chase it. This time however, I learned some things from the last attempt and used a combination of RCS and Torch to catch up with VORB. Docking with VORB was still complicated by the angle I had to come at, but I managed to successfully dock anyway.

Once at VORB, I did repairs to the areas affected by micro meteors, discovering that one of the rotors got completely destroyed. The destruction of the one rotor did how ever give the plastic scrap needed to fix the other one that was damaged, the sacrafice will not be forgotton. Fixed a cargo pod, as well as a breach in the fuel room, and then started some auto task repairs for most of the main room/navigation area.

Another lesson I learned tonight is that the positions of Venus and OKLG will greatly affect what path the auto pilot will take to leave the orbit. My usual exit location was not going to work, in fact it wanted to plot backwards past the back of the planet and come back around to go back to OKLG. Instead of taking that course, I waited another hour or two to be in a different position and plotted from there.

The trip back to OKLG went smooth without any issues. The media cargo sold for around 8mil. 3.6 of which was put towards an asteroid residence, that comes with its own private dock free of fees.

A fitting end to one hell of an adventure. I look forward to returning to this game again for the next major update with a fresh new run.

所以，在写这篇评测时，我已经在这款游戏里投入了1527个小时。这款游戏有着磁带未来主义主题的外观和感觉（想象一下1979年的《异形》，旋钮和按钮）。故事设定在太空，一场灾难使得地球轨道无法安全通行，导致太阳系的其他部分被隔绝。

超级资本主义控制着一切，一切都想榨干你的每一分钱。你幸运地一开始就有一艘破旧的飞船……但它背负着沉重的抵押贷款，必须每6小时分期偿还。

这款游戏不会手把手教你，你或多或少得自己弄清楚一切。有一本手册解释了基本的飞船功能、反应堆设置等等等等。去读它。这是你唯一能得到的帮助。

有一个教程会引导你找到你的第一艘废弃飞船，从中打捞各种设备，可能还有一张打捞许可证……哦，我忘了提吗？当地空间站连死掉的飞船都拥有，你可以打捞任何你想要的东西，但要合法地做，你需要一张许可证……然而他们并不在乎你是如何“获得”这张许可证的……又不是上面写着名字什么的……否则你可以直接买它们……如果你买得起的话。

总之，基本的游戏循环就是打捞东西、修理打捞物，然后卖给许可证供应商、废品供应商，或者如果你够圆滑，卖给有时会为某些物品/数据文件支付高价的黑市商人。

你的目标是还清你的飞船，之后，太阳系或多或少就是你的囊中之物了。你可以打捞设备并出售，甚至打捞整艘飞船，目的是用它们的骨架来扩建你的飞船。或者你甚至可以购买废弃飞船，修好后再转售，或者自己使用，或者你甚至可以以超高价格购买能用的二手飞船。一切，无论大小，只要你能找到想要/需要的零件，都可以修改，你的想象力就是极限。

最终，你有了一个反应堆，你可以开始使用与之关联的驱动器前往其他行星。买卖货物来赚大钱，购买你的公民身份（是的，即使你出生在某个地方，你仍然是非法的）。公民签证会带来其货物交易商的折扣，这意味着货物运输能赚更多钱。

这款游戏唯一的缺点是有些东西解释得不太清楚，你要么得问别人，要么得用试错法，这可能会有点让人望而却步。

NPC的AI也相当糟糕，尽管它在改进，并且与不久前的状态相比已经有了很大进步。话虽如此，我不建议雇佣NPC船员，因为你几乎要微观管理他们做的每一件事。然而，这毕竟是抢先体验版，在AI能够真正被处理和修复之前，所有游戏功能都需要先添加。所以它会在接近发布时改进。

但一旦你掌握了这款游戏，你就会有像下面这个例子一样的体验，这是我今晚结束当前游玩过程的经历：

-----------------------------------------

今晚一开始，我疯狂地尝试与金星大气层中的一个空间站对接，确切地说是长滩终端。

在与浮空器对接的过程中，我学到了很多教训。首先，我一开始就消耗了太多RCS来下降到大气层，实际上在下降途中就用完了N2。

由于行星强大的引力，你必须燃烧高G反向推力来保持恒定速度，否则你会在很短的时间内速度增加数百米/秒。话虽如此，我当时已经没有RCS了，正朝着行星坠落。

打开我的旋翼（其中两个在下降途中被微型陨石损坏），只能祈祷好运。最终，当大气压力达到15Kpa时，旋翼开始不仅仅用于旋转，我得以减速并与空间站保持对接高度，勉强成功对接。

在空间站停靠期间，我购买了一些媒体货物，准备稍后带回OKLG。

当我准备离开时，我解除对接并学到了几件事：海盗并不总是拥有足够强大的飞船来摆脱金星的引力，因为我看到一艘追踪我的飞船坠向行星并最终被摧毁。我还学到，虽然4个旋翼足以让我的飞船不坠向行星，但它们不够强大，无法将飞船提升到大气层边缘。

第一次尝试离开金星，我设法使用RCS离开了“无尾流区”，但很快意识到我没有足够的RCS到达VORB，于是开始了第一次手动火炬飞行尝试。

我启动了火炬驱动器，弄清楚了如何用它进行机动，并开始前往VORB，但不幸的是，我不知怎么地使反应堆过热，损坏了烧蚀衬里，导致响起了响亮的警报，基本上结束了第一次尝试，因为我没有多余的衬里。教训学到了。

重新加载存档，并使用SFF（时间跳跃最多6小时）额外跳了一小时，让VORB更靠近行星。以防万一，购买了额外的反应堆烧蚀衬里，然后解除对接，进行第二次尝试返回VORB。

这一次，我一解除对接就切换到RCS，全速冲向尾流区边缘。

这一次，由于VORB近得多，它实际上从头顶轨道经过并越过了我们，我不得不追赶它。然而这一次，我从上次尝试中学到了一些东西，使用RCS和火炬的组合来追上VORB。与VORB对接仍然因为我必须进入的角度而复杂，但我还是成功对接了。

一到VORB，我就修复了受微型陨石影响的区域，发现其中一个旋翼被完全摧毁了。不过，一个旋翼的摧毁提供了修复另一个受损旋翼所需的塑料废料，这次牺牲不会被忘记。修复了一个货舱，以及燃料室的一个破口，然后开始对主房间/导航区域的大部分进行一些自动任务修复。

Fun but way too many bugs as of now, full of stuttering and other problems.
Turning off ceiling mode and pressing alt turns it back on, you need to go back to menus to turn it off again.
Zone designations barely work, sometimes drag clicking adds tiles to a zone, sometimes it does not, if a zone ends near a corner tile, there is a chance that your character will infinitely stack items on top of a wall tile.
Path finding is abysmall, the characters always choose the shortest path even though it might take 3x longer.
Some UI Elements seem to sometimes just flat out dissapear and not reappear until you reload the save.
The character needs menu does not work as intended, it might be 10% full but the tooltip says that the character is very tired, same goes with food and thirst.
Combat is very janky and unintuitive.
Very tedious to change out and recharge tool batteries when you are expanding your ship, not only the building itself is time consuming, navigating the inventories of rechargers and your tools is tedious.
You can rearrange your inventory bars... untill you close your inventory and once you open it up again, they are all in default spots, it might take up to half the screen if you have enough inventories on you.
You can hire crew and set their schedules, sadly the idiots refuse to sleep before you manually remove their helmets, what's the point of a schedule when you have to babysit each and every one of the crew?
Hauling command makes the game less tedious but is implemented poorly, the crew will deliver as many items at a time as many there are on a single floor tile, even though they could pick 20 nearby items and stash them in their inventory, they will rather take 20 trips than one.
Water... there are tanks for many different gasses in the game, but for water you need to manually go and buy water bottles to refill your sinks, making sinks basically useless since you can do all the water based interactions of the sink straight from the bottles

关闭天花板模式后按alt又会把它打开，你得回到菜单才能再次关掉它。
区域划定几乎没法用，有时候拖拽点击会给区域添加格子，有时候又不会，如果某个区域在角落格子附近结束，你的角色就有可能无限地把物品堆叠在墙格上。
寻路糟糕透顶，角色总是选择最短路径，哪怕那可能会多花3倍的时间。
有些UI元素似乎有时会直接消失，直到你重新加载存档才会重新出现。
角色的需求菜单没有按预期工作，可能只满了10%，但提示却说角色非常疲惫，食物和口渴也是一样。
战斗非常别扭且不直观。
在扩建飞船时更换和充电工具电池非常繁琐，不仅建造本身耗时，浏览充电器和工具的物品栏也很烦人。
你可以重新排列你的物品栏栏位……直到你关闭物品栏，等你再次打开时，它们全都回到了默认位置，如果你身上带够多物品栏，它可能会占掉半个屏幕。
你可以雇佣船员并设置他们的日程，可惜这些白痴在你手动摘掉他们的头盔之前拒绝睡觉，当你不得不照看每一个船员时，日程还有什么意义？
搬运命令让游戏没那么繁琐，但实现得很差，船员一次会运送和单个地板格上一样多的物品，哪怕他们本可以捡起附近20件物品并把它们塞进自己的物品栏，他们也宁愿跑20趟而不是一趟。
水……游戏里有各种不同气体的储罐，但水却需要你手动去买水瓶来给水槽加水，这让水槽基本没用，因为水槽所有基于水的互动你都可以直接用水瓶完成

Edit: tried it again Sept 16, 2026. Just give me my ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ money back. I couldn't get through the tutorial. Where is the "Nav station"? What do any of the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ starting traits even DO? Why am I clicking on any of these ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ things? What an utter piece of ♥♥♥♥ this "game" is.....


The short version: this game is a janky, broken mess that screams out for a quality-of-life pass. I deeply regret buying it, and a significant portion of my 16hrs of playtime were spent redoing things that broke, or just trying to figure out some very basic things. It's bad. Avoid.

Longer version: I love Hardspace: Shipbreaker. I love games where you can salvage and build. The salvaging and building part of the game is... fine. It functions. You can right click on a thing, click "uninstall", and your character uninstalls it. You can right-click a thing, click on "repair" or "restore" and they do that. You need a variety of tools to do these things, and some of them need power. Cool. All of this is great.

And then the wall of your (broken down) ship breaks due to wear and tear, and you need to repair it. Awesome! Some urgency! But... You can't repair the wall cause the cooler is in the way. Fine, fine, I'll just uninstall the cooler: done. Repair the wall? Easy. I'll just put the cooler back now... Oh... I can't install the cooler? In the spot where it just was? But... It was just there?

The placement grid is all translucent grey, so that means there's nothing in the way... But, of course, there can't be anything in the way because how else could the cooler have been where it was? How could I have uninstalled it if there were things in the way. Maybe I need to be able to access the outside of my ship?

A long, long time passes while I figure out how to safely access the outside of my ship: nope, still can't install the cooler.

Turns out that if you really, REALLY zoom all the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ way in, the corners of one of the placement squares *around* the cooler (note: not the cooler itself) is a very mild tinge of pink. Meaning there's an N2 canister in the way. But if the N2 canister is in the way of the install, how the ♥♥♥♥ did I UNinstall the cooler?

There are several times where I intentionally "dropped" a dolly (essentially a large shopping cart) and coudn't pick it back up. Why? Who ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ knows, the game sure isn't telling me.

If you drag a component you have legitimately salvaged into the station and start dismantling it in the public space, security will rush over and arrest you. Why? It's a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ mystery.

How does Character creation work? What do the choices *mean* in the context of the game? What does "skilled" mean? If I'm "5% training" in a skill, how much does the skill increase per relevant skill use? Also: what the ♥♥♥♥ do these skills enable? What do they DO? What do I need them for? In what way are they relevant? Why did dismantling a sleeping bag increase my ***structural engineering*** skill, ffs?

This is in addition to broken quests, and irrelevant things that just don't make any sense. For example, I received an SOS from an NPC ship who wanted fuel. Sure, sez I, and zipped over as quick as I could.
Me: "I'm requesting docking"
NPC: "♥♥♥♥ you, back off"

Um... What? The transponder call-sign matched the ship, but... They just preferred to drift in space.

You get random quest pop-ups: Some dude calls you and wants to talk, you should find and speak to him.
Me: Cool. Where is he.
Game: *shrug*
Me: ok, but he called me and asked to meet. Did he give me a ship name?
Game: *shrug*
Me: is he on this station?
Game: Nope.
Me: So....?
Game: ♥♥♥♥ you.

It's a broken janky mess that, I'm sure, will be fantastic in about 10 years from now. Right now, though? I'd be annoyed if I had only paid CA$5 for this, but pissed that I paid CA$20. (I'm normally a superfan of SplattercatGaming, but I really feel he misrepresented this one as being so much way better than it actually is)

详细版：我喜欢《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》。我喜欢那种可以打捞和建造的游戏。这游戏的打捞和建造部分……还行。它能运转。你可以右键点击一个东西，点击“卸载”，你的角色就会把它卸下来。你可以右键点击一个东西，点击“修理”或“恢复”，它们就会那么做。你需要各种各样的工具来做这些事，其中一些还需要电力。酷。所有这些都很棒。

然后你那艘（破败的）飞船的墙壁因为磨损而破裂了，你需要修理它。太棒了！有点紧迫感！但是……你没法修墙，因为冷却器挡道了。行吧行吧，我先把冷却器卸下来：搞定。修墙？简单。我现在把冷却器装回去……哦……我装不上冷却器？就在它刚才所在的位置？但是……它刚才就在那儿啊？

放置网格全是半透明的灰色，所以那意味着没有东西挡道……但是，当然不可能有东西挡道，不然冷却器怎么可能在它原来的位置？如果有东西挡道，我怎么可能把它卸下来。也许我需要能够接触到飞船的外部？

过了很长很长一段时间，我终于搞明白如何安全地接触到飞船外部：不行，还是装不上冷却器。

结果发现，如果你真的、真的把视角♥♥♥♥♥♥♥拉到最近，冷却器*周围*的某个放置方格（注意：不是冷却器本身）的角上有一丝非常轻微的粉色。意思是有一个N2罐挡道了。但如果N2罐挡住了安装，那我♥♥♥♥到底是怎么把冷却器卸下来的？

有好几次我故意“丢下”一辆推车（基本上就是一个大购物车），然后就捡不回来了。为什么？谁♥♥♥♥♥♥♥知道，游戏肯定没告诉我。

如果你把一个合法打捞来的部件拖进空间站，然后在公共区域开始拆解它，保安会冲过来逮捕你。为什么？这是个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥谜。

角色创建是怎么运作的？那些选择在游戏语境下*意味着*什么？“熟练”是什么意思？如果我在某个技能上有“5%训练”，那么每次相关技能使用时技能会提升多少？还有：这些技能到底♥♥♥♥能解锁什么？它们*做*什么？我需要它们干什么？它们在哪些方面相关？为什么拆一个睡袋会提升我的***结构工程***技能，我靠？

这还不算那些坏掉的任务，以及那些毫无意义、根本说不通的东西。比如，我收到一艘NPC飞船的求救信号，他们想要燃料。当然，我说，然后以最快速度飞了过去。
我：“我请求对接”
NPC：“♥♥♥♥你，退后”

呃……什么？应答器呼号跟那艘船是匹配的，但是……他们就是宁愿在太空里漂着。

你会随机收到任务弹窗：某个家伙打电话给你想谈谈，你应该找到他并跟他说话。
我：酷。他在哪。
游戏：*耸肩*
我：好吧，但他打电话给我，让我去见他。他给我船名了吗？
游戏：*耸肩*
我：他在这个空间站上吗？
游戏：不在。
我：所以……？
游戏：♥♥♥♥你。

这是个破破烂烂的烂摊子，我相信，大概10年后它会变得非常棒。但现在呢？如果我只为它花了5加元，我会恼火，但我花了20加元，我很生气。（我通常是SplattercatGaming的超级粉丝，但我真的觉得他把这款游戏说得比实际好太多了）

I bought this game a couple years ago but decided to wait for further development after half an hour. Recently a friend tried it and so I decided to give it another chance.
I have put 40 hours into it this week.

This game has a lot of issues. Inventory micromangement is terrible, a lot of tasks that seem like they should be handled automatically by autotask aren't (swapping batteries is the most notable), there isn't much content in some areas such as equipment with most functional ship parts having only one example per class, it often stutters for unclear reasons, as far as I am aware you get no information on the price of a new employee until after you hire them, there is no automation of transferring gasses between canisters, the list goes on.
I recommend this game because it is heavily systems driven with things like atmospheric pressure and gravity/acceleration being very well modeled while the core loop of going and ripping things apart to sell to stay alive is to me extremely satisfying. The steady progression of struggling debt slave to small business owner is one I wish more games had.

这款游戏有很多问题。物品栏微观管理很糟糕，很多看起来应该由自动任务自动处理的任务并没有（换电池是最明显的），某些领域内容不多，比如装备，大多数功能性飞船部件每个等级只有一个例子，它经常因为不明原因卡顿，据我所知，在你雇佣新员工之前你得不到关于他们价格的任何信息，没有在罐之间转移气体的自动化，这样的例子还有很多。

items.text:
It's good good potential (like a lot of early access titles) the core loop is OK but very grindy with a lack of the sort of impactful variety of objects.  

Good: 
There are some commendable mechanics, ie battery powered tools, rechargers.
There is a good amount of build flexiblity if you like squares.
A good variety of textures to theme your ship the way you like.
An intriguing mission system that seems to have good variety on the surface at least.
The docking minigame is a fun feature.

Bad:
The procedurally generated ships are often nonsensically so.  
Combat is weird with all the pausing and unclear action/reaction stuff going on.
There isn't a lot of component level variety that has any real impact on the finished product.
Where you can/should sell each item is really unclear so you wind up walking around a lot to find someone to buy things.
The uninstall is boring slow/tedious.
Once you get an EVA suit the O2/Power limitation becomes non-existant making it just a grind fest of collection.

Ugly:
Current bug that I've hit (now on 3rd playthru try to avoid) - I get a warrant, get arrested either pay 15k or lose 3 years of life in prision.  If you are captured out in space you lose your entire ship and stuff.  The warrant seems to randomly come back (sometimes immediately) requiring another 15k or 3 years.  It's aggravating as you don't have any clue as to why you are "wanted" all the sudden.  Super frustrating and ultimately why I'm done playing for a spell until they are farther along.
items.text_zh:
它很好，潜力很大（像很多抢先体验游戏一样），核心循环还行，但非常肝，缺乏那种有影响力的物品多样性。

好：
有一些值得称赞的机制，比如电池供电的工具、充电器。
如果你喜欢方块，有很好的建造灵活性。
有各种各样的纹理，可以按你喜欢的方式为你的飞船设定主题。
一个有趣的任務系统，至少表面上看起来有很好的多样性。
对接小游戏是个有趣的功能。

坏：
程序生成的飞船往往毫无道理。
战斗很奇怪，有各种暂停和不清楚的动作/反应。
没有很多组件级别的多样性对最终产品有真正的影响。
在哪里可以/应该出售每件物品真的很不清楚，所以你最终会走来走去寻找买家。
卸载无聊、缓慢/繁琐。
一旦你得到EVA服，O2/电力限制就变得不存在了，使其只是收集的肝。

丑：
我遇到的当前bug（现在第三次游玩尝试避免）——我得到逮捕令，被逮捕，要么支付15k，要么在监狱里失去3年生命。如果你在太空中被捕获，你会失去整艘飞船和东西。逮捕令似乎会随机回来（有时立即），需要再支付15k或3年。这很恼人，因为你完全不知道你为什么突然被“通缉”。超级令人沮丧，最终也是我暂时停止玩的原因，直到他们进展更远。

I don't know how to review this game to be honest. 

There's definitely something cool here, I really like the premise of being a loner in space with my ship, going around salvaging and exploring the solar system. It feels like it could be a really good game.

It might be the tutorial that's putting me off, I'm not sure, it breaks really easily and doesn't really show the game's true potential I don't think.

I'm going to play a bit more and come back with an update, I'm on the fence with this one right now!
----------------------------
Edit, Update after 17 hours of play time

I'm enjoying the game for the most part, it definitely takes time to get used to. 
I had to watch a few youtube videos to find out how to build and expand my ship.

It still needs a fair bit of polish, the UI can be clumsy, boxes popping up all over the place. I don't get any warnings when my ship battery is running low, or if I'm running low on O2 or N2. At one point my ship just turned off, I didn't know why, I ended up having to google what had happened - My ships battery had ran out!

Sometimes when I dismantle items in my ship, if I'm close to a wall, the items spawn outside the ship and cannot be retrieved if you are docked at a station.

When my EVA suit is running low on battery, I don't get any prompt of any kind, then my character starts to aphyxiate and I didn't understand why until my character passed out and I started clicking stuff randomly - only to find out the battery was at 0%.

It was hard to figure out how to get my character to sleep, the only way I could do it was by setting 2 hours of sleep on the "roster" and then telling my character to sleep in a bed at the station, then using hyper fast forward I managed to get them to sleep for 2 hours - This is a complicated mechanic and needs explaining better.

It would be GREAT if we could label/name crates and bins, and/or change their colour - at present, all the bins and crates look the same and I keep forgetting what I put in which one. If I could label one as O2 Bottles, another as Batteries, another as scrap metal, it would be a brilliant quality of life addition.

Another thing I've noticed is the performance, I'm not sure if the game has a memory leak or something, but the longer I play the game, the lower my frame rate gets over time. (I'm running a RX 9070XT, 32Gb RAM and a R7 3700X) Eventually my fps starts to drop to like 29 and I have to save and re-load the game, weird!

Overall I am enjoying the game, the gameplay loop is addictive and stripping wrecks of parts to sell or install on my own ship is very satisfying.

The game is very promising, with a bit of polish and some better tutorials I think it could be a great game.

说实话，我不知道该怎么评价这款游戏。

这里肯定有很酷的东西，我真的很喜欢这个设定：独自一人在太空中，驾驶着自己的飞船，四处打捞、探索太阳系。感觉这本来可以是一款非常棒的游戏。

也许是教程让我望而却步，我不确定，它很容易出问题，而且我觉得它并没有真正展现出游戏的潜力。

我打算再玩一会儿，然后回来更新，目前我对这款游戏还在犹豫！
----------------------------
编辑，游玩17小时后的更新

大部分时间我挺享受这款游戏的，它确实需要花时间适应。
我不得不看了几个YouTube视频，才搞清楚如何建造和扩展我的飞船。

它仍然需要相当多的打磨，UI可能很笨拙，各种框到处弹出来。当我的飞船电池电量低，或者我的O2或N2不足时，我得不到任何警告。有一次我的飞船直接关机了，我不知道为什么，最后不得不上网搜发生了什么——我的飞船电池耗尽了！

有时当我在飞船里拆解物品时，如果我靠近墙壁，物品会生成到飞船外面，而如果你停靠在空间站，就无法取回它们。

当我的EVA宇航服电量低时，我得不到任何形式的提示，然后我的角色开始窒息，我不明白为什么，直到我的角色昏过去，我开始随机点击东西——才发现电池电量是0%。

很难搞清楚如何让我的角色睡觉，我唯一能做到的方法是在“名册”上设置2小时睡眠，然后让我的角色在空间站的床上睡觉，接着使用超快进，我才设法让他们睡了2小时——这是个复杂的机制，需要更好地解释。

如果我们能给箱子和储物箱贴标签/命名，和/或改变它们的颜色，那就太好了——目前所有储物箱和箱子看起来都一样，我总是忘记哪个里面放了什么。如果我能把一个标为O2瓶，另一个标为电池，再一个标为废金属，那将是一个极棒的生活质量改进。

我还注意到的另一件事是性能，我不确定游戏是否有内存泄漏之类的问题，但我玩得越久，帧率就会随着时间越来越低。（我用的是RX 9070XT、32Gb内存和R7 3700X）最终我的fps开始掉到大概29，我不得不保存并重新加载游戏，真奇怪！

总的来说，我很享受这款游戏，玩法循环很上瘾，从残骸上拆下零件去卖或安装到自己的飞船上非常令人满足。

这款游戏非常有前途，只要稍加打磨和一些更好的教程，我认为它可以成为一款很棒的游戏。

*In short, Sims in space. Quickly becoming my favorite game. Cant wait for the 1.0 so I can get lost again*

Let me tell you a story of me getting this game.
Several months ago I picked this up on sale, smoked a bowl and booted the game up, was digging the hell out of it, not really paying attention, took me like 2 hours to get to the point where I could get a ship lol. Feeling a little overwhelmed (remember high and the games pretty complicated) I wander around the station not really knowing wtf is going on or what im doing, trying to figure everything out and following the Tutorial. I sit in the cockpit and the nav screen clicks on and holy smokes! I am WAY to high to try to figure this ♥♥♥♥ out. Turned it off and played some Helldivers 2 probably. 

Recently ive been yearning for a solid Scifi RPG. Recently started playing Space Station 14 again, played SS13 over a decade ago a lot. But I commonly play lit and keeping up with the mostly chill vibe im looking for. I randomly saw Ostranauts in my list of games trying to find something to play and the cover art caught my eye so i booted it up, forgot all about it tbh. Didnt remember anything about the game (Playing high again lol), I sat down in the Nav console and OH CRAP THIS GAME AGAIN! and I closed it laughing. then i sat there and thought, "If I dont try it, I almost always play lit, ill never play it". So I launched it again and slowly learned what the hell I was doing lol. 

The next thing I know its 6am and im wide awake, went to sleep, woke up 6 hours later (I have insomnia and sometimes struggle to sleep or stay asleep) and start playing again. Literally the next thing I know it was 6 am again. This literally happened during the Presidents day weekend and most of the day before after work. 

This game is nearly everything I could have wanted in a space game. Im a big SciFi nerd and love Hard SciFi (Think more Expanse and less Star Trek) its just complicated enough for me to have to learn and feel accomplished. The first time a meteorite or something slammed into my hull taught me to compartmentalize, im trying to not save scum unless im testing a game system to make sure i get how it works. and forced me to react, I try to play real time when doing things, I speed up time when hauling and stuff. For me its a very immersive Space life sim, Im just my Character just trying to make it, no goals unless I want goals outside of making money for my loan. 

I have a tenancy of losing interest in games after 20 or so hours, rarely go games hold me for over 100 hours, Never in 1 fracking week lol. I understand this game is going 1.0 next year, I worry ill have the same problem I have with many EA games, Is I burn out on them and dont want to have to redo that part to see the new stuff, or too much time has passed and I forgot about it completely. This will be the first game I will tag for follow, I want to know everything about this game. However knowing thats a risk im getting all my enjoyment from it now, Assuming ill have to restart on 1.0, I hope I am just as enthralled with this game again. 

Now im not saying its not a buggy mess, complicated, many annoying UI issues, information that's hard to find (How ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ often is long term docking fees charged? whats the point of PDAs, etc), bad AI, Really cool conversation system but convoluted and hard to understand (Should take inspiration from the sims), not being able to tell your guy to auto build using specific materials, instead they will grab anything (so you have to build your ship manually if you want it looking a specific way) among many MANY issues. But even with all that, the times im not playing im thinking about what ill be going once I hop on, caught myself while out to dinner sketching out ship designs at Chilis lol. 

Im finally at the point where im docking my ship and tearing it all apart and building my Dream ship, Solo (No crew), and I want to have an outer hull with a technical corridors (with breaks using more TC) so when something hits me (Looking at you F*** Around and Find Out! MF has hit me 3 times and busted my ship.

I dont know if its accurate but it feels like Star Citizen/Elite Dangerous Meets Rimworld Meets The Sims all Single player. 

From what im reading the goals, this game will lose me, my body will be found at this computer with this game running... Mr EMS or my wife, please seal whatever leak killed me, I spent a lot of time and money on this ship, its all I have lol. 

Also good god how do you improve firearms use without blowing a hole in my suit every time?

*简而言之，太空版模拟人生。迅速成为我最喜欢的游戏。等不及1.0了，这样我就能再次迷失其中*

让我给你讲讲我得到这款游戏的故事。
几个月前，我在打折时买了它，抽了一碗，然后启动了游戏，玩得超级投入，没怎么注意，大概花了2个小时才达到能弄到一艘船的地步，哈哈。感觉有点不知所措（记得当时嗨了，而且游戏相当复杂），我在空间站里闲逛，不太知道到底发生了什么，也不知道自己在做什么，试图弄清楚一切并跟着教程走。我坐在驾驶舱里，导航屏幕亮了，我的天！我嗨得太过头了，根本没法搞明白这♥♥♥♥。关掉游戏，可能去玩了一些《地狱潜者2》。

最近我一直渴望一款扎实的科幻RPG。最近又开始玩《空间站14》，十多年前玩过很多《空间站13》。但我通常玩得比较嗨，保持着我所追求的那种大多时候很放松的氛围。我在游戏列表里随机看到《奥斯特拉诺茨》，想找点东西玩，封面艺术吸引了我的眼球，所以我启动了它，说实话，完全忘了它。不记得关于这游戏的任何事（又玩嗨了，哈哈），我坐在导航控制台前，哦靠，又是这游戏！我笑着关掉了。然后我坐在那里想，“如果我不尝试，我几乎总是玩嗨，我永远不会玩它”。所以我又启动了它，慢慢学会了我在搞什么鬼，哈哈。

接下来我知道的就是早上6点，我完全清醒，去睡觉，6小时后醒来（我有失眠症，有时难以入睡或保持睡眠），又开始玩。真的，接下来我知道的又是早上6点。这 literally 发生在总统日周末，以及之前下班后的大部分时间。

这款游戏几乎是我对太空游戏想要的一切。我是个超级科幻迷，喜欢硬科幻（想想更多《苍穹浩瀚》，少点《星际迷航》），它刚好复杂到让我必须学习并感到有成就感。第一次陨石或什么东西撞上我的船体，教会了我分区，我尽量不存档作弊，除非我在测试游戏系统以确保我明白它如何运作。并迫使我做出反应，我在做事时尽量实时玩，在运输东西时加速时间。对我来说，这是一个非常沉浸式的太空生活模拟，我只是我的角色，只是努力生存，除了为我的贷款赚钱之外，没有目标，除非我想要目标。

我有个倾向，在玩20小时左右后对游戏失去兴趣，很少有游戏能让我玩超过100小时，从来没有在1个该死的星期内，哈哈。我知道这款游戏明年要出1.0，我担心我会遇到许多EA游戏的问题，就是我会玩腻，不想重做那部分来看新内容，或者时间过得太久，我完全忘了它。这将是我第一个标记关注的游戏，我想知道关于这款游戏的一切。然而知道这是个风险，我现在就获取所有乐趣，假设我必须在1.0时重新开始，我希望我能再次如此着迷于这款游戏。

现在我不是说它不是个满是bug的烂摊子，复杂，许多烦人的UI问题，难以找到的信息（长期停靠费到底♥♥♥♥♥♥♥多久收一次？PDA有什么意义，等等），糟糕的AI，非常酷的对话系统但 convoluted 且难以理解（应该从模拟人生中汲取灵感），不能告诉你的角色使用特定材料自动建造，而是他们会抓任何东西（所以如果你想船看起来特定样子，你必须手动建造）以及许多许多问题。但即使有所有这些，我不玩的时候都在想我一上线会做什么，在Chilis外出吃饭时发现自己草图设计飞船，哈哈。

我终于到了停靠我的船，把它全部拆开，建造我的梦想船的地步，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（使用更多TC来断开），这样当什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，弄坏了我的船。

我不知道是否准确，但感觉像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人。

从我读到的目标来看，这款游戏会失去我，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还在运行……EMS先生或我妻子，请封住杀死我的泄漏，我在这艘船上花了大量时间和金钱，这是我的一切，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么提高枪械使用而不每次都在我的宇航服上炸个洞？
他们会随便抓取任何东西（所以如果你想让飞船看起来有特定的样子，就必须手动建造），这只是众多问题中的一小部分。但即便如此，当我不玩的时候，我都在想我一上线要做什么，有次在外面吃晚饭时，我发现自己竟然在Chilis餐厅里画飞船设计图，哈哈。

我终于到了把飞船停靠、全部拆开、建造我的梦想飞船的阶段，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（用更多TC来制造隔断），这样当有什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，把我的飞船搞坏了。

我不知道这准不准确，但感觉就像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人模式。

从我读到的目标来看，这游戏会让我迷失，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还开着……EMS先生或者我老婆，请把我因为什么泄漏而死的地方封住，我在这艘飞船上花了很多时间和金钱，这是我的一切了，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么才能在每次不把自己的宇航服打出一个洞的情况下提高枪械使用技能？

items.text:
I am obsessed with this game.  It scratches every inch of what I like in games.  Exploration, building, looting, commerce, all of it is there.  The UI is a bit off putting, the learning curve is there but it's not too steep.  Play the first few characters with the expectation that you will fail, and learn from what you did wrong.  Docking mini-game does become easier with practice.  TLDR:  It's a heck of a lot of fun and has taken up lots of my free time in the past week.  Highly recommend!

Wishlist:
Social:
I'd like to see the social aspects improved (it's a little murky what I'm doing sometimes) and it is a necessary part of the game to interact with.  I can't see both my own social stats and the person I am interacting with at the same time.  So I have to click on myself, see what needs are low (Intimacy, Contact, Family, etc.) and then back to the person I'm talking to.  It's a bit cumbersome.  

Orders & inventory:
Maybe there is already a way to do this, but when I send my character to uninstall large amounts of things they uninstall and drop them on the floor even if there is space in my inventory.  I'd like uninstall to automatically go into my pack or dolly by default with a way to turn that off if possible.  I saw something about Haul zones somewhere but I haven't been able to find it again.

Repair Priority:
I'd like to see repairs go by priority of need rather than proximity, especially if there is a collision and it causes a pressure, leak.  again, maybe that's already in the game but I'm not sure how to set it up if it is.

我对这款游戏着迷了。它满足了我对游戏喜好的每一个方面。探索、建造、搜刮、贸易，全都在那里。用户界面有点让人望而却步，学习曲线是有的，但不算太陡峭。玩前几个角色时就抱着你会失败的心态，并从你犯的错误中学习。对接小游戏确实会随着练习变得更容易。长话短说：它超级好玩，在过去一周里占用了我大量的空闲时间。强烈推荐！

愿望清单：
社交：
我希望看到社交方面得到改进（有时候我在做什么有点模糊不清），而且与它互动是游戏的必要部分。我无法同时看到我自己的社交属性和我正在互动的人。所以我必须点击我自己，看看哪些需求低（亲密、联系、家庭等），然后再切回我正在交谈的人。这有点麻烦。

订单与库存：
也许已经有办法做到这一点，但当我派我的角色卸载大量物品时，它们会卸载并把东西丢在地上，即使我的库存里有空间。我希望卸载默认自动进入我的背包或推车，如果可能的话，有一个可以关闭这个功能的选项。我在某处看到过关于搬运区的东西，但我一直没能再找到它。

维修优先级：
我希望看到维修按需求优先级而不是按距离来进行，尤其是在发生碰撞并导致压力、泄漏的情况下。再说一次，也许游戏里已经有了，但如果是的话，我不确定该如何设置。

i dunno how this gets to 1.0 in a year, the salvaging and building system is a slog, you cannot mass deconstruct then plan a build on the parts you've selected to deconstruct. even the ship designer system in game is bare bones and a pain to use. you can't refuel, charge and pay your docking fee's from within your ship either, baffling; but that fits the lack of design care in game as your char will fly out an airlock naked no issue and has no complaints about his EVA suit quality, the game can autopause on being attacked but lets you eat vacuum no issue. then there is the 2077 issue of everyone in the game having your contact info and pestering you. it's like an overly complicated poor mans hardspace shipbreaker but not nearly as fun because you're not problem solving, you're accounting.

what i don't see:
mining
manufacturing
non-ship structures to own/build

the game is overly narrow minded where it counts as a space game and overly complex where it doesn't need to be in its sim city goofery [seriously, the fence sees me as a lover for somereason and keeps lightly touching my arm but i hit flirt and apparently they've a hoon meter like you do for your bowls and it's fully evacuated as well so they turn me down, ...], it's "TL;DR" currently not worth it, not even at the sale price. it says i have 20 hours but i forgot it was running in the taskbar at nine hours in; i looked up why the game is lagging hard every minute, couldn't find a fix, forgot i was playing and i had to force myself to get to nine hours in. the game feels barren as all the 'it's a storyboard' games are that rely on you being the content like a solo d&d session.

采矿
制造
可拥有/建造的非飞船建筑

这款游戏在作为太空游戏的关键之处过于狭隘，而在不需要的模拟城市式胡闹之处又过于复杂[说真的，那围栏不知为何把我当成恋人，一直轻轻碰我的手臂，但我点了调情，显然他们有一个像你玩保龄球那样的兴致计量条，而且也是完全空的，所以他们拒绝了我，……]，目前来说“长话短说”就是不值得，即使打折也不值。它显示我玩了20小时，但我在9小时的时候忘了它还在任务栏里运行；我查了为什么游戏每分钟都严重卡顿，找不到解决办法，忘了自己在玩游戏，不得不强迫自己玩到9小时。这款游戏感觉空洞，就像所有那些“它是个故事板”的游戏一样，依赖你自己成为内容，就像单人跑团一样。

items.text:
Ostranauts is a top down 2d space scavenger game with ship building mechanics and a simple atmosphere and orbital dynamics simulator. It also looks like there is the intent to have heat simulation and some crew interaction simulation. There is a hypothetical long range travel,  but its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else. Note that you have to use the autopilot as you cannot manually use the long range drive. That the characters die unless you manually feed them every few hours also make long distance travel atrociously annoying. It would be so simple to have them auto consume food, water and sleep when fast forwarding, but instead they just randomly die. 

and cant really say anything about it. The main game loop consists of scavenging various derelicts and building up your ship, and paying of the loans you have on the starting ship, avoiding spending too much on fuel and oxygen. This aspect is somewhat fun, but the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious. It would be a good idea to keep track of only a few kinds of mechanically different floors, and keep the texture of the floor separate from the type, and the same holds for walls. The shipbuilding is fun but due to storage mechanics rather tedious. The power mechanics are very opaque and there is no way to see how much something will draw. There is a system for character progression, well maybe, it still levels up the skills you already have, and when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it, but it does look like its there... The amount of work needed is also wildly varying and disproportionate. Combat and conversation is lousy, again mostly due to bad ui. It would be better if you entered into a  different kind of menu for it, rather than needing to scroll around and guess what things do. 

There should also be difficulty related to managing food, drink and atmosphere and heat, but these systems are nearly trivial to maintain, or bugged. There is also no recycling of food drink wast etc, no greenhouses, and strangely no solar panels or radio isotope generators. The occasional loss of power, or fuel, or crashing nav station are all fun things mini events but can be a bit too punishing in some cases. 

There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun. 

The problem is the bugs. Bugs like your character equiping a space helmet for no clear reason and then falling unconsious once the air runs out while inside your ship where the atmosphere is fine. Bugs like the various character status bars being difficult to intrepet, or again bugged. Bugs like not needing to go to the bathroom for months before suddenly nearly dying due to not having been in the last few minutes over and over again. Bugs like station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind.  Bugs like losing the ability to left click on things, which is the main mode of interaction, bugs like the character randomly committing suicide in various ways. The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save which is the only way to fix most bugs. Please upgrade to protobufs with an arena and stop using zipped jsons... Also the game badly needs longer range for a* when searching for valid paths and valid haul locations. 

The game is really promising, but just not ready for release yet. If you are willing to live with alot of unintuitive ui, jank the game is fun as is, but it still needs alot of work.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》是一款俯视视角的2D太空打捞游戏，带有飞船建造机制，以及一个简单的大气与轨道动力学模拟器。看起来它还打算加入热量模拟和一些船员互动模拟。游戏里有一种假想中的远距离航行，但它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管我尝试了几十次，还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近。注意，你必须使用自动驾驶，因为你无法手动使用远距离驱动器。角色除非你每隔几小时手动喂他们一次，否则就会死，这也让远距离航行变得极其烦人。在快进时让他们自动消耗食物、水和睡觉本该是件很简单的事，但他们却只会随机死掉。

而且对此真的没什么可说的。主游戏循环包括打捞各种废弃飞船、逐步建造自己的飞船、偿还你在初始飞船上的贷款，同时避免在燃料和氧气上花太多钱。这方面还算有点意思，但游戏的主要难点本质上就是记住你把某样东西放在哪里了。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。只追踪少数几种在机制上不同的地板，并把地板贴图与类型分开，会是个好主意，墙壁也是如此。造船很有趣，但由于存储机制而相当繁琐。电力机制非常不透明，而且没有办法看到某样东西会消耗多少电。有一个角色成长系统，嗯，也许吧，它仍然会提升你已经拥有的技能，而当它们终于达到100%时，你什么也得不到，但它看起来确实存在……所需的工作量也变化极大且不成比例。战斗和对话很糟糕，同样主要是因为糟糕的UI。如果进入一种不同类型的菜单来处理这些，而不是需要四处滚动并猜测东西是干什么的，那会更好。

还应该有与管理食物、饮水、大气和热量相关的难度，但这些系统维护起来几乎微不足道，或者就是有bug。也没有食物、饮水、废物等的回收利用，没有温室，而且奇怪的是没有太阳能板或放射性同位素发电机。偶尔的断电、断燃料或导航站崩溃都是有趣的迷你事件，但在某些情况下可能惩罚过重。

有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不知道任何东西是干什么的情况下，乐趣也会减少。

问题在于bug。比如你的角色毫无明确理由地装备上太空头盔，然后在空气耗尽后失去意识，而当时你还在自己飞船内部，那里的大气明明没问题。比如各种角色状态条难以解读，或者同样有bug。比如几个月都不需要上厕所，然后突然因为过去几分钟内没上过厕所而反复濒临死亡。比如如果你在某个地方待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样倒下，留下他们的贵重物品。比如失去左键点击物体的能力，而这是主要的交互方式；比如角色以各种方式随机自杀。游戏加载和保存也慢得惊人，而这是修复大多数bug的唯一方法。请升级到带arena的protobuf，别再使用压缩的json了……另外，游戏在搜索有效路径和有效拖运位置时，非常需要为A*提供更长的搜索范围。

这款游戏真的很有前景，但还没准备好发布。如果你愿意忍受大量不直观的UI和粗糙感，游戏目前这样也挺好玩，但它仍然需要大量工作。

Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

I really want to like this game but elements of it's design just feel hostile. Character creation... I have absolutely no idea if I should try and maximise money and skills in the character creator or just play the game? I did a scavenging run and when I got back to the station I was arrested... Never told what I did wrong but now I have more debt (That's fine, I just wish I knew what I did?) Plus I get stutters every 10 or so seconds which really grinds on you.

I won't refund but I think the devs need to just 100% focus on performance and clarity of information. Maybe have an opt in story driven tutorial where an experienced salvager takes you out on a mission and shows what you should even be looking for? Should I uninstall every single floor tile to get as much money as possible or get big items from multiple ships? No idea.

Cool idea that I want to get into but it just might be a bit too obtuse right now.

To many bugs and inconsistency in the game you go to uninstall a wall in the center of your ship next thing you know the wall stays the floor goes along with the conduit and your pressurized space. if your docking and less than 10 seconds away from hard dock a patrol ship can literally force a hard dock then spin your ship 37000 km away into empty space. Not to mention random meteor strikes that hit the same location six times. Not to mention buggy conversations the auto build not being able to find the parts when you took the time to place them in neat little stacks right next to the build site. 

After a reboot and update and starting a new game some of the problems went away it still on occasions does odd things with the patrol ship docking the last instance was I could not get the officer to leave my ship after coming back from prison the said officer sent me to. I installed a exercise device and he would not stop using it.

 I would only recommend Ostranauts to people who have a high tolerance for figuring things out on there own and dealing with frustration well is a must. This is not space engineers, with years of videos and help files. Others may want to wait till the truly adventurous figure out things and write help files and video there solutions.

After playing for over 120 hrs I can honestly say that Ostranauts is a game the is hard to get a good read on there is so much possibility with what could be. Its defiantly staying on my ssd as the loading between almost docking and docking can jar my system in to being unresponsive for 4 to 5 seconds its the same for any action that changes the point of view.

I will close the wall of text by saying frustrations and bugs aside I cant stop playing.

After 134 hours of play and many frustrations, with many hours spent building up a ship from a tin can of almost certain death to a stable and great cargo caring life sustaining titan, I must admit I am done till the next patch, the only suggestion I would give is to fire your crew the minute they kill them self's doing something stupid, its going to happen and its morbid but hay its ether that or pay a corps. 

I am back at it as of the last update opt in and I have to say the new game play additions and more involved reactor construction has me hooked again. Still when you get in to the later stages of the game the lag issues and the control issues it causes can be quite frustrating still the progress on the game is great. Still not for the faint of heart or easy to frustrate.

I have to say the game has greatly improved to the point I can suggest it to the slightly space realism addicted persons such as my self. the only thing I can say needs work is the save system after a save there is a pause that is very hard to miss and can lead to a miss click read as oops there goes that wall. The pause also occurs during docking but its not as critical after you get used to docking.
items.text_zh:
游戏里有太多bug和不一致之处，你去拆掉飞船中央的一堵墙，结果接下来你会发现墙还在，地板却连同管道和你加压的空间一起没了。如果你在对接时距离硬对接不到10秒，一艘巡逻船可以硬生生强行硬对接，然后把你的飞船旋转到37000公里外的空旷太空中。更别提随机陨石撞击会六次击中同一个位置。更别提有bug的对话，自动建造在你花时间把零件整齐地堆放在建造点旁边时却找不到它们。

在一次重启和更新并开始新游戏后，一些问题消失了，但它偶尔仍会在巡逻船对接时做出奇怪的事情，最后一次是我无法让那名军官离开我的飞船，那是在从监狱回来后，正是那名军官把我送进去的。我安装了一个锻炼设备，他就一直用个不停。

我只会向那些对自行摸索事情有很高容忍度、并且必须能很好应对挫败感的人推荐Ostranauts。这不是《太空工程师》，没有多年的视频和帮助文件。其他人可能想等到真正有冒险精神的人弄清楚事情并写出帮助文件和视频解决方案。

在玩了120多个小时后，我可以诚实地说，Ostranauts是一款很难准确评价的游戏，它有着太多可能成为的样子。它绝对会留在我的固态硬盘上，因为几乎对接和对接之间的加载会让我的系统卡住4到5秒无响应，任何改变视角的操作也是如此。

我将以这句话结束这堵文字墙：撇开挫败感和bug不谈，我停不下来。

在玩了134小时并经历了许多挫败之后，我花了很多小时把一艘几乎必死的铁皮罐头飞船建成一艘稳定、出色的运货、维持生命的巨舰，我必须承认，在下一个补丁之前我不玩了，我唯一能给的建​​议就是，当你的船员做蠢事害死自己时，立刻解雇他们，这种事会发生，虽然很病态，但嘿，要么这样，要么付钱给尸体。

随着最近一次选择加入的更新，我又回来了，我不得不说，新的玩法添加和更复杂的反应堆建造让我再次上瘾。不过，当你进入游戏后期阶段时，延迟问题及其导致的操控问题仍然相当令人沮丧，但游戏的进展很棒。仍然不适合胆小的人或容易被激怒的人。

我不得不说，游戏已经大大改进，到了我可以把它推荐给像我这样稍微对太空写实上瘾的人的程度。我唯一能说需要改进的是存档系统，存档后会有一个很难错过的暂停，可能导致误点被当成哎呀那堵墙没了。暂停也会在对接时发生，但在你习惯对接后就没那么关键了。

I don't put negative review for the game, since early game is really entertaining, you get quite fancy and unusual exploration game play for 3-4 days. I don't want to go into details, discover it yourself.


In general the game is promising. My congrats to developers. I would like to see more content, for example:
- Show actual ship and base boundaries on the map. Show every airlock in form of squire as you do now. Create multiple air locks, so multiple ships can dock at the same time to the base. Create multiple types of air locks, so every air lock type should have its own size of docking area. The docking area should be visible in install mode. So when we install air lock we should see the area where ship would be docked. So that docking area should occupy space in build mode and not allow to build rooms and ship structures over it. The opposite should be the same, If my ship docked to some airlock, my ship boundaries should be constrained by the size of the docking area I am in. Charge different fees for docking of different size ships. Kill or injure player if it managed to be in the docking area at the moment of another ship docking,
 - Greatly expand the base size. Create limitless by capacity warehouse to store trade goods. Create some special crates having huge space inside, so the base's warehouse would accommodate everything. Visualize trade activity, so NPCs would move the trade goods in and out of the ship to that warehouse. If ship has no space, there should be area at the dock for temporary storage of the purchased goods. Add leisure activities for NPCs at the base: Clubs, Arcades, Hotel, Hospital, Bath House, Barber Shop, etc. So NPCs should do something meaningful at base. They should dock and go for trade, leisure activities, health, education and etc. So they should not just roam from one end of the corridor to another. Add service removing NPCs dead bodies from the base. It is not nice for player to do that.
- There should be some trade/supply activity in the space background performed by NPC. They should travel from port to port and bring in/out goods. At this moment NPCs ships activities have no meaning.
- Add pirates to the game. Add regular police patrols so it is possible to avoid them and skip paying license fees. It should be possible to see them coming on the radar and avoid them somehow: the ship is faster, clocking device, pretend to be a scrap metal, pretend to be a police patrol, false SOS alarm, etc.
- Ideally game should support arcade mode for ship to ship fighting, the existing navigator map is perfect for that, it scales map indefinitely, you just have to add full screen mode and more battle related equipment and controls. Cannons may have similar UI as the docking mechanism to aim and fire. Missiles should have limited fuel capacity so they should have limited maneuverability, so it should not be very difficult to dodge them. Make everything slow and weak in terms of damage. Add possibility to automatically seal rooms in time of hull breach,
- Add possibility to scavenge ships and pickup staff in space without docking. It requires slow docking mode, so it is possible to see 2 ships side by side on the map. Probably it is deviation from the original docking idea.

Other wishes for the game:
- Make ships equipment significantly different in size, for example:
small ship battery - 2 x 2 squares
mid size ship battery - 5 x 5 squares
large ship battery - 10 x 10

Fix possibility to navigate ship without dropping carried large item. Otherwise it is possible to pick large object and having no space at ship fly away with it. 

Make the same for engines and all other ship equipment, so it is possible to upgrade ship from small to large in stages. At this moment upgrade mechanics end when ship gets all the available equipment. 

Balance game so small ship having powerful engine should be able to escape from pirates and have opportunities for doing expensive gigs, but at the same time its limited cargo space should make it less convenient for scavenging and trade.

Make it possible to have multiple airlocks, so it should be possible to dock some ship and then tow it into the nearest port to disassemble or sell. Balance game, so heavy ship should be difficult to move, so scavenging should be always the first option. Add some heavy weight cargo to the game, for example containers with raw minerals or ship parts. Some trade goods.

Add possibility to cut rooms out of existing derelicts  and build them into the users ship. Cutting users ship into pieces and regrouping them should also be possible. Add some equipment for that, some tractor beam, to push parts of the ship around in space.  Consume a lot of energy for that, so it is not that easy with small ship to do.

It might be very difficult, but if you make it possible to break ship apart by powerful acceleration, so loose parts of the ship just break away, it would be very nice as well.

Add some tools to find leaks in the hull.

Add star gates for acceleration between planets.  They should be broken in the beginning of the game, so there should be a quest to fix them. They might have the same mechanics as a docking, some area in space to navigate to, but instead of docking to air lock, the ship should be placed in some acceleration area and then pilot should pay for for destination and required acceleration.

If derelict has no power, the user should float inside like in space. 我不会给这个游戏差评，因为前期真的很有趣，你能在3-4天里体验到相当花哨且不寻常的探索玩法。我不想深入细节，自己去发现吧。


总的来说这个游戏很有前途。祝贺开发者。我希望看到更多内容，例如：
- 在地图上显示实际的飞船和基地边界。像现在这样以方形显示每个气闸。创建多个气闸，这样多艘飞船可以同时停靠到基地。创建多种类型的气闸，每种气闸类型应有自己尺寸的停靠区。停靠区应在安装模式下可见。所以当我们安装气闸时，应该看到飞船将停靠的区域。因此该停靠区应在建造模式下占据空间，不允许在其上建造房间和飞船结构。反过来也应如此，如果我的飞船停靠到某个气闸，我的飞船边界应受我所处停靠区大小的限制。对不同尺寸飞船的停靠收取不同费用。如果玩家在另一艘飞船停靠时恰好处于停靠区，就杀死或伤害玩家，

items.text:
Early Access disclaimer: A bit rough around the edges and no endgame yet. Watch this one for a bit before a purchase, or grab it now to help support the devs.

What we have here is a pretty comprehensive simulation of working as a highly indebted scrapper in space. Right now the game has a lot of fun features that can add hours of enjoyment. updates and patches come frequently enough to get you to update and play consistently. But there's also the fact that this is one of those games where you're going to want to play over to get better at it. There's a certain amount of rng when it comes to what ships you dock with and what kind of scrap you'll find.

The only drawbacks are that in order to make the game more realistic, actions take too long and doing things requires far too much effort. i.e. inventory management is tough to do since you can't carry large parts. It makes sense if something is very heavy that you shouldn't be able to just throw it into your backpack. So you have to drag it instead. This realism is vastly missing in games for good reason imo. No one wants to brush their teeth in a game or do quarterly taxes. We want to play the game! So it makes sense to omit such actions that aren't immediately relevant to the game we're playing. Unless it's a tax planning simulator where good teeth are good for business?

But even in the rise of survival games with "complete" management of your character's status is adding a lot of seemingly superfluous actions, this game goes a bit further. From eating to bowel movements, oxygen intake to temperature regulation, it makes sense that you need to keep your character alive in the extreme hazards of space. That being said, there are a few things I could live without and a few actions that could be automated or sped up for quality of life improvements. For instance, although there is a speed up time function, the game typically crawls at 1 second per second. If your character had to sleep 8 hours, you'd find yourself watching them overnight in real time. Something you have to pay attention to and wake the character up when something happens like the authorities trying to dock with you. If you sped the game up to 4x, you'd still be sitting there for 2 hours of real time. So it's not hard to see why the devs have lowered the sleep time dramatically to account for that. However, it still feels like you're doing actions that take too long a bit too frequently. That's the sacrifice between realism and simplification. You could wait minutes or longer for actions to complete, or the devs could simply speed up the process to allow players to play the game.

The pitfalls of the category notwithstanding, this is still an incredibly detailed game that adds in a plethora of reasons why the exploration of space should not be taken lightly, even if you're a lowly wreckage scrapper. 8/10.

抢先体验免责声明：还有点粗糙，而且还没有终局内容。购买前可以先观望一下，或者现在就入手来支持开发者。

我们这里有的是一款相当全面的模拟游戏，让你扮演一个在太空中负债累累的废料回收者。目前这款游戏有很多有趣的特性，能带来数小时的乐趣。更新和补丁发布得足够频繁，能让你持续更新并稳定游玩。但也要知道，这是那种你会想要反复游玩以变得更擅长的游戏之一。你对接的是什么飞船、会找到什么样的废料，都存在一定的随机性。

唯一的缺点是为了让游戏更真实，动作耗时太长，做事情需要付出太多精力。比如，物品栏管理很难做，因为你不能搬运大型部件。如果某个东西非常重，你不应该能直接把它扔进背包里，这很合理。所以你必须拖着它走。依我看，这种真实感在游戏里大量缺失是有充分理由的。没人想在游戏里刷牙或者做季度报税。我们想玩游戏！所以省略那些与我们所玩游戏并非直接相关的动作是合理的。除非这是一款税务规划模拟器，而牙齿好对生意有帮助？

但即便在生存游戏兴起、对角色状态进行“完整”管理、加入大量看似多余动作的潮流中，这款游戏还更进一步。从进食到排便，从氧气摄入到体温调节，在太空的极端危险中你需要让角色活下去，这很合理。话虽如此，有几样东西我可以不要，还有几个动作可以为了生活质量改进而自动化或加速。例如，虽然有时间加速功能，但游戏通常还是以每秒一秒的速度缓慢推进。如果你的角色需要睡8小时，你会发现自己得实时看着他睡一整夜。你还得留意，在发生事情时把角色叫醒，比如当局试图与你对接。如果你把游戏加速到4倍，你仍然得在那里坐上2小时的真实时间。所以不难看出为什么开发者大幅缩短了睡眠时间来解决这个问题。然而，仍然感觉你过于频繁地在做耗时太长的动作。这就是真实感与简化之间的取舍。你可以等几分钟甚至更久让动作完成，或者开发者可以干脆加快流程，让玩家能玩上游戏。

尽管这类游戏有这些陷阱，这仍然是一款极其细致的游戏，加入了大量理由说明为什么探索太空不应被轻视，即使你只是个卑微的残骸回收者。8/10。

This game is WAY freaking cool. Its also one of the only games ive ever wanted multiplayer.
But damn its buggy. like palmetto season, like an Egyptian curse, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ locust swarms.

Creating vibes in a video game is difficult, but damn i do feel like im an Ostranuat with this game...
This game is super hard sci-fi and heavy in detail. I was surprised at how quickly i picked everything up, given its complexity i thought i was going to have a harder time tbh, but its all fairly intuitive. Hardest thing for me is telling one pixel from another... Objects can stack which just blends it all together, making a mess of the screen.

Also its ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hard... I mean like, you can spend several hours getting your ♥♥♥♥ together to simply get stuck. I still dont really know how to play the game tbh.
Given all the game breaking bugs, I would heavily suggest the devs make custom difficulties available, ranging from needs, fines to fuel and a better tutorial. Also cheats, while i agree they ruin games, but ending a run because of bugs is even worse. I would also love to see more accessibility options. Like color blindness, and more and better overlays.
There were several notable bugs, some game breaking.
Eg. when you save your game, you have no idea at what point its saved. So you can loose 10 mins of game play when you reload the game.
There was a power glitch when i ran unbuilt cable, it still connected the power. The game thought those cables existed when they were not built yet.
I tried to repair a power generator, added all components but it would not repair past 99.99%.
Sometimes when uninstalling something, the item will disapear. Which can be devastating.

If the devs clean up the bugs, this could easily be one of my favorite space games.

在电子游戏里营造氛围很难，但该死的，玩这款游戏时我真觉得自己是个Ostranuat……
这款游戏是超级硬科幻，细节繁重。我很惊讶自己这么快就上手了，考虑到它的复杂性，我以为会更难，说实话，但一切都相当直观。对我来说最难的是分辨一个像素和另一个像素……物体可以堆叠，这就把它们全混在一起，把屏幕弄得一团糟。

而且它真他妈的难……我的意思是，你可以花好几个小时把你的♥♥♥♥整理好，结果只是卡住。说实话，我到现在还不太知道这游戏该怎么玩。
鉴于所有这些破坏游戏的bug，我强烈建议开发者提供自定义难度，范围从需求、罚款到燃料，以及更好的教程。还有作弊，虽然我同意作弊会毁掉游戏，但因为bug而结束一局更糟。我也很想看到更多无障碍选项。比如色盲，以及更多更好的覆盖层。
有几个值得注意的bug，有些会破坏游戏。
例如，当你保存游戏时，你根本不知道它保存在哪个时间点。所以当你重新加载游戏时，可能会丢失10分钟的游戏进度。
当我铺设未建成的电缆时出现了一个电力故障，它仍然连接了电力。游戏以为那些电缆存在，而它们其实还没建好。
我试图修理一台发电机，添加了所有组件，但它就是无法修过99.99%。
有时卸载某样东西时，物品会消失。这可能是毁灭性的。

如果开发者清理掉这些bug，这很容易成为我最喜欢的太空游戏之一。
