items.text:
Entertaining, for early access.
-Fun to learn while dying type game
-Awesome character generation, repeats after a few times
-Fixing/building your ship is fun while it is breaking down
-Cops coming for you to check on your license is funny
-Crew social is very interesting, buggy, but interesting

Really needs a lot more work though - bugs from 1/12/23:
-After visiting a few derelicts and having a lot of stuff on your ship, it will start becoming choppy/low fps
-The orders management is cool, yet fails/crashes a lot
-Inventory UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the huge text, you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move, which is both annoying and sometimes rarely useful
-Social UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the small text
-Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
-Esc key, escapes everything except right click menu
-The crew will constantly interrupt you, repair a hole in the hull, doesn’t matter
-No good way to get crew to stop interrupting aside from mod, which removes it completely
-Crew will constantly go outside without helmets and die lock doors if you could get all the codes
-Crew dying on another ship, you cannot drag them to your ship, fire them and leave them to die (or extra eva suit)
-Cops will ram you
-Bugs/lacking in many ship systems, airlocks are almost pointless since you cannot automate them and lose air fast. (sure you can manually vacuum the space, but the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while)
-Nav station won’t list all door codes, and you have guess which door is which code
-Lots of skills are useless, some do a little, 4 of them do a lot
-Making money/economy is weird - you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all. If you have a loan, you will be bogged down in bills, store refreshes every 4 shifts, but you have to pay the loan every shift... So you get the ship that doesn't have a loan and then it becomes pointless
-Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh

Wishes: 
-multiplayer, or at least better crew. 
-Easy way to make ships and add them to the game without modding. 
-Simple switch automation (at least a proximity switch)
-By the time you find the Cart, you really don’t need the cart
-Simple crafting - cart, change 02 sensor to N2, cart, blue light to red light, cart

Tldr: After 100+ hours played, the bugs will beat you into not wanting to play this awesome game. Worth $20, yea

items.text:
This game embodies slice-of-life in a near-future dystopia. With elements that feel similar to stories like Firefly, Cowboy Bebop, and the Expanse, it conjures a world of stratified classes, desperation, and small triumphs: Getting ahead of predatory debts, finding just the right component in a locked away hulk, and sleeping soundly (if not comfortably) in a rescued tin can. You're not a hero by conventional standards - but just surviving in Ostranauts requires a sort of heroism itself. In terms of other games, it feels a bit like the end of Hardspace: Shipbreaker, where you ride off into the sunset in something to call your own.

It's not pretty. It's not much. But it's yours. And you have to earn it, each step of the way. This game is hard science fiction in that it attempts to recreate the realities of living in space, from building effective HVAC and power systems in a vacuum to the long-term health effects of zero- and low-g habitation. The one major conceit it hasn't approached has been zero-g (I probably shouldn't be walking upright while barefoot - where are those magnetized boots?).

Mostly, the core game mechanics are difficult but *fun* and *rewarding*. It's still very much an early access piece: There's no overarching or procedural story (though that's on the roadmap), there's quite a few bugs (though the developer does their best to quash game-breaking ones quickly), and the tutorial and supportive documentation are very barebones. However, what is there is amazing.

Each update brings a massive amount of content or mechanics - enough that elements of the game can change drastically. The roadmap looks promising, and the only thing not on it I'd like to see would be a more direct hand in actually breaking down ship systems on wrecks (More active shipbreaking). However, the updates have each been regular and reliable. In short, this feels what Early Access games should actually feel like. It's not everything I want in a game like this yet, but it's enough that I feel good in writing a positive review for its future.

这款游戏体现了近未来反乌托邦中的日常生活片段。其中的元素让人感觉类似于《萤火虫》、《星际牛仔》和《无垠的太空》等故事，它构筑了一个阶级分层、绝望与微小胜利并存的世界：摆脱掠夺性的债务、在锁闭的废弃船体中恰好找到合适的部件，以及在获救的罐头盒里安然入睡（即便并不舒适）。按传统标准，你并非英雄——但仅仅在奥斯特拉诺茨生存下来，本身就需要一种英雄气概。就其他游戏而言，它感觉有点像《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的结尾，你乘着某种可以称之为自己的东西驶向夕阳。

它不漂亮。它不算什么。但它是你的。而你必须一步一步地赢得它。这款游戏是硬科幻，因为它试图再现太空生活的现实，从在真空中建造有效的暖通空调和电力系统，到零重力和低重力居住对健康的长期影响。它尚未触及的一个主要设定是零重力（我大概不该光着脚直立行走——那些磁化靴子在哪？）。

大体上，核心游戏机制很难，但*有趣*且*有回报*。它仍然非常像一款抢先体验作品：没有 overarching 或程序化生成的故事（尽管这在路线图上），有相当多的 bug（不过开发者会尽力迅速消灭那些破坏游戏的 bug），而教程和支持性文档非常简陋。然而，已有的内容非常棒。

每次更新都带来大量内容或机制——多到游戏中的某些元素可能发生剧烈变化。路线图看起来很有希望，唯一不在上面而我希望看到的，是能更直接地亲手拆解残骸上的飞船系统（更主动的拆船）。不过，每次更新都规律且可靠。简而言之，这感觉才是抢先体验游戏真正该有的样子。它还不是我想在这类游戏中想要的一切，但已经足够让我乐于为其未来写一篇好评。

Update 2
Really want to play this game but there are so many bugs. The world is great! The mechanicals are just my kind of brutal and I love the free form ship designing. But I cannot complete a full day of playing because I run into game breaking bugs.
I get trapped on a police ship that undocks while I am talking to the officer who has just stolen all my gear. Then, because it has so many thrusters on it, it runs out of fuel while heading back to the station and we smack into it at 750 Meters per second and some how live to walk onto the station. Now though I have to take a taxi back to my ship which has travelled over 20000km and I nearly run out of fuel getting back to the station myself only to find that I cant dock.
I will admit the bugs are responsible for some epic adventures but it destroys the game. 

Update 
There is a new update that kinda kills the game. The new Inventory system is good, don't get me wrong, but they went a little too far. The new mechanics make building your ship a chore and no longer fun. Previously you could carry stacks of five floors/walls. Now you can only drag one. I get that thirty stacks of five are a bit much, but going from that to only be able to slowly drag one of them is the other extreme. Cant recomend the game any more.

Love this game, but cant play for more than an hour or two without encountering a game breaking bug.

items.text: It's a lot of fun. Definitely worth the 20 hours I put into it but that's about as much content as there is. Learning to select a good background, traits and starting ship, learning how to utilize and make everything function, is challenging and fun. It is also a bit maddening when you die of sudden asphyxiation and you have no idea why. Could be a missing floor or wall tile you missed. Maybe your airlock isn't quite air tight. You'll figure it all out eventually over a number of deaths though. At the end I scavenged a comfortably large ship with a fusion reactor and once I was ready to embark again I came across a near perfect ship twice the size with only 1 wall hole. Otherwise perfect with a full reactor setup. So that's when I quit. I just didn't want to go through the slog of moving all of my ship parts over bit by bit and I didn't want to leave my perfectly good ship to rot as a derelict either. Hopefully there's a tug feature added at some point. I looked at the road map and it features everything you would likely want. Just gotta give this game another year or two and i'll be a solid gem.

items.text:
[Edit after a few more hours into the game 16 Sept 2020]

It's an open/sandbox game where you start with a simple pod with a battery and barely enough energy to a scrapyard where you'll start salvaging broken ships to expand yours.

It kinda reminds me of Barotrauma for the idea of ship complexity but with the full liberty of creation and of Hellion, for the free roaming/exploration/salvaging/navigation, both games I love.
The idea is great and allows a lot of freedom in creating your very own ship.There are interesting game mechanisms for object placement, connections, air, temperature,  electricity and so on.There seems to be quite a fair amount of randomly generated narrative, for instance at the creation of your character. 
Some panels, like the docking or the reactor, are really nice and add a lot to the immersion, I love it.
Graphics are a very poor 3d but it's a style I don't mind actually.
Thanks to the few patches of the first days, I've been able to navigate a bit and dock to the first derelicts. 
Generated randomly between another rescue pod or a large spaceship, in a poor or rather ok state.

Now, onto the very bad parts.
Even though I should be tolerant with an early access game, it is difficultly playable and very grindy.
- All actions take a lot of time, (but you can accelerate time)
- Cursor location bugs, where you need to restart the game every so often.
- Docking procedure very unclear, I understood that one, you have to face the derelict with the tip of your ship even though your airlock is at the back... Once you know
- very harsh balance where you'll grind heavy objects and sell them to get a very necessary tool at the beginning
- also, not helping, most of the derelicts are so broken that you can't even enter them at the beginning
- swapping the batteries at the beginning is a chore and you'll end unlucky by finding no derelict with reactor to recharge them on
- very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.
- items that you lose for no good reason
- stuffs you can't remove
- some of the sounds in this game are also kinda horrific, like proximity alarms that will not shut down when docked
- some bugs are actually favorable like infinite O2
- lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
- pieces of the ship that are not repaired yet with no indication
- items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want
- Pressure, mass, temperatures, gravity that go haywire
- and some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
The list is quite long

So basically, it feels like a game with nice game mechanics but not polished, extremely buggy and configured to be grindy with high chances of death and it questions why I'm spending time in the game. It really needs to become more friendly to the player.
I'm sure the game could become something in the end but unless you want to support the developer, to be avoided for now.

I'll likely change my mind in future updates and review this frequently

That kinda reminds me of the state of disarray that was Space Engineers at the beginning.
items.text_zh:
[在游戏里多玩几个小时后于2020年9月16日编辑]

这是一款开放/沙盒游戏，你一开始只有一个带电池的简易舱，能量勉强够你到达一个废料场，在那里你将开始打捞破损的飞船来扩展你自己的飞船。

它让我有点想起《Barotrauma》，因为飞船复杂性的理念，但拥有完全的创造自由；也让我想起《Hellion》，因为自由漫游/探索/打捞/航行，这两款游戏我都喜欢。
这个想法很棒，允许你在创建自己飞船时拥有很大的自由。对于物体放置、连接、空气、温度、电力等，都有有趣的游戏机制。似乎有相当数量的随机生成的叙事，例如在你创建角色时。
有些面板，比如对接或反应堆，真的很好，大大增加了沉浸感，我很喜欢。
画面是非常糟糕的3D，但这其实是一种我不介意的风格。
多亏了最初几天的几个补丁，我已经能够稍微航行一下，并对接到最初的几艘废弃飞船。
它们是在另一个救援舱或一艘大型飞船之间随机生成的，状态很差或还算可以。

现在，来说说非常糟糕的部分。
尽管我应该对一款抢先体验游戏保持宽容，但它很难玩，而且非常肝。
- 所有动作都要花很多时间，（但你可以加速时间）
- 光标位置bug，你需要时不时重启游戏。
- 对接程序非常不清楚，我搞明白了那一个，你必须用你飞船的尖端面对废弃飞船，尽管你的气闸在后方……一旦你知道了
- 非常严苛的平衡，你一开始得肝沉重的物体并把它们卖掉，才能得到一个非常必要的工具
- 而且，更糟的是，大多数废弃飞船破损得太严重，一开始你甚至无法进入它们
- 一开始更换电池是件苦差事，而且你会很不走运地发现没有一艘废弃飞船有反应堆可以给它们充电
- 目前进展/目标非常少，但我相信这会被修正。
- 你会无缘无故失去的物品
- 你无法移除的东西
- 这款游戏里有些声音也有点可怕，比如接近警报在对接后不会关闭
- 有些bug实际上是有利的，比如无限氧气
- 缺少快速执行诸如解除对接之类操作的选项
- 飞船尚未修复的部分没有任何指示
- 你无法把物品放在地板上你想要的位置，你必须不停地拿起又放下，直到它们到了你想要的位置
- 压力、质量、温度、重力会失控
- 还有一些更致命的bug，比如由于解除对接时的bug，你的飞船基本上会无缘无故坠毁并被摧毁。
这个清单相当长

所以基本上，感觉像是一款游戏机制不错但未经打磨、bug极多，并且被配置成很肝、死亡几率很高的游戏，这让我质疑自己为什么要花时间在这游戏里。它真的需要对玩家更友好一些。
我相信这款游戏最终可能会有所成就，但除非你想支持开发者，否则目前还是避开为好。

在未来的更新中我可能会改变想法，并经常重新评测

这让我有点想起《Space Engineers》刚开始时那种混乱状态。

items.text:
This game is gonna need a lot of work. 

The first thing I did when I started up the game was try to design my own ship. Every time I would click, nothing would be placed and so I couldn't build my ship. Oh well I'll just play the game instead except because I had designed a ship with no parts, my spaceship had no parts which meant my character would automatically spawn in space with no spaceship. Fun times.

I had to uninstall then reinstall the game in hopes that the edited ship was not permanent. Luckily it was not but there were significantly limited options for character creation. Perhaps the other careers just aren't ready yet but it was aggravating to see the other options for careers and not be able to play them. 

I designed my character, had a few options for how to set myself up, was bothered that I couldn't carry everything I bought at the trader station so it just left my items on the ground rather than bringing them to my ship. I finally get to see the incredibly small & puny ship. It was just pathetic but I decided to persevere and started driving the spaceship. Driving it is incredibly difficult. I started driving towards something and the ship immediately began breaking apart. Before I could even make it to the thing I was driving to my spaceship leaked too much oxygen and I died.
items.text_zh:
这游戏还需要大量的打磨。

我启动游戏后做的第一件事就是尝试设计我自己的飞船。每次我点击，都没有任何东西被放置上去，所以我没法建造我的飞船。算了，那我就直接玩游戏吧，只不过因为我设计了一艘没有任何部件的飞船，我的太空船就没有任何部件，这意味着我的角色会自动在太空中生成，却没有太空船。真是好玩。

我不得不卸载再重新安装游戏，希望那艘被编辑过的飞船不是永久性的。幸运的是它确实不是，但角色创建的可选项明显非常有限。也许其他职业还没做好，但看到有其他职业选项却没法玩，实在让人恼火。

我设计好了我的角色，有几个如何配置自己的选项，让我很烦的是我没法把在商人空间站买的所有东西都带上，所以它就把我的物品丢在地上，而不是把它们带到我的飞船上。我终于见到了那艘小得可怜、微不足道的飞船。它简直惨不忍睹，但我决定坚持下去，开始驾驶这艘太空船。驾驶它极其困难。我开始朝某个东西开过去，飞船立刻就开始解体。我还没能开到我正驶向的那个东西那里，我的太空船就漏了太多氧气，然后我就死了。
